releases.title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC GROUP AND ELEVENLABS ANNOUNCE MULTI-YEAR STRATEGIC AGREEMENT, BEGINNING WITH A NEW LICENSED AI MUSIC CREATION PLATFORM
releases.body:
First-of-its-kind collaboration spans licensing and product development  

New platform, to be launched by ElevenLabs, will enable fans to create remixes, mashups and new interpretations of tracks from participating artists 

SANTA MONICA, Calif. and NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, and ElevenLabs, the leading AI audio research and product company, today announced a multi-year licensing agreement and wider strategic collaboration to launch a new AI-powered music platform for fans as well as to jointly develop AI audio products for artists and songwriters.  

The groundbreaking agreement – ElevenLabs' first with a major label – encompasses licensing and product development. It reflects the companies' shared commitment to the principles that AI-enabled music innovation should be built responsibly, respect human artistry, and enable artists and songwriters to share in the value created.  

The ElevenLabs-UMG relationship will begin with a new AI-powered music creation platform built on licensed music and artist participation. Now in development, the platform will give fans new ways to co-create with music from participating artists and songwriters, including through remixes and mashups, new track interpretations, and personalized vocal experiences. The agreement also includes the development of additional products and fan experiences in the months and years to come. 

"The most exciting possibilities for AI and music are those that put artists, songwriters, and fans at the center," said Sir Lucian Grainge, Chairman & CEO, Universal Music Group. "UMG and ElevenLabs are aligned that responsible AI can inspire discovery, deepen engagement between artists and fans, and unlock new revenue opportunities for the creative community. ElevenLabs' leadership in AI audio brings a new dimension to our growing ecosystem of partners committed to expanding what's creatively and commercially possible for human artistry." 

"AI opens up incredible possibilities for interacting with our favorite music and artists," said ElevenLabs cofounder and CEO Mati Staniszewski. "By combining UMG's global community and rights management expertise, with our AI models and products, we'll enable artists and songwriters to create powerful new experiences for their fans, and ensure they are fairly compensated."   

The new platform will be distinct and offered separately from ElevenLabs' existing music products, which include: 

  • Music API – ElevenLabs' studio-grade music models available via API, used by music technology, media & entertainment, social media, and other leading businesses and developers globally. 
  • ElevenMusic – ElevenLabs' music creation app for generating and editing original songs, with granular control over vocals, instrumentation, style, arrangement and other elements of a track. 

About Universal Music Group

At Universal Music Group, we exist to shape culture through the power of artistry. UMG is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising and audiovisual content. Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information on Universal Music Group N.V. visit www.universalmusic.com. 

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company. It builds AI voice and audio models, creative tools, and conversational agents across 70+ languages. Millions of consumers, developers, governments, and businesses use ElevenLabs – including employees at two-thirds of Fortune 500 companies. With its models and platform, the company aims to transform how people and businesses communicate with the world.

FULLERTON, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026 /CNW/ -- Blast Media Print (Blast Media Inc.), a large-format printing and visual branding company founded in Vancouver, BC, has opened a new production location in Orange County, California. The facility gives Southern California businesses direct, local access to the same large-format print capabilities Blast Media has built its reputation on: banners, retail signage, window and wall graphics, vehicle wraps, UV direct printing, trade show displays and more.

The new location is positioned to serve the region's busiest commercial markets, including Los Angeles, Orange County's retail and corporate corridors around South Coast Plaza and Irvine, the Anaheim Resort district, and the medical corridor in the City of Orange. It also extends coverage to the Inland Empire, North San Diego County, and -- with the same turnaround standards -- the San Francisco Bay Area.

"Southern California has been one of our fastest-growing markets, and it made sense to put a team and a facility on the ground here rather than keep shipping everything down from Vancouver," said Allan Louie, CEO and Founder of Blast Media Print. "This location lets us give Orange County and the surrounding region the same fast turnarounds and hands-on production our clients already count on."

"This isn't just a new address for us," said Quinn Louie, Owner and Director of Operations. "It's us telling clients in Southern California -- and across the U.S. -- that we're always finding new ways to serve them better. That's what this location is all about." said Quinn Louie, Owner and Director of Operations.

Built for Fast Turnarounds Across the Region

releases.body:
An interactive Candy Country music experience invites fans to explore the track and unlock rewards, including VIP trips to meet the artists on tour

NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Candy Crush® is bringing together globally celebrated songwriter, artist and performer Shania Twain and Grammy Award-winning DJ and producer Zedd to give nearly 30 years of nostalgia a whole new sound. Today, the casual mobile game kicks off its annual Music Season in-game event with a candy-coated, dancefloor-ready reimagining of the song, "You're Still the One."

The track sets the pace to an interactive music video that transports fans to Candy Country — a glittering, candy-coated Western fantasy world where it rains rhinestones, roadhouse saloons shimmer like gumdrops and rainbow rapids rush in technicolor. Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Jonas Åkerlund, the video brings his distinctive visual storytelling to the Candy Crush Saga universe, transforming the game's playful spirit into a world filled with surreal moments. Look a little closer and fans will find hidden clues throughout the video that could unlock a range of prizes.

Fans can head to candyroadhouse.com to enter, seek out the blue sugar stars, and hunt for rewards.* The stakes are high with six lucky winners scoring a VIP trip to meet Shania Twain or Zedd on tour. Fans can also get their hands on signed bandanas and one-of-a-kind pieces straight out of the music video itself, including Shania's baby pink hero outfit with fringe detail as well as Zedd's rhinestone-encrusted helmet.

At the center of it all is a gift to the fans who've loved this song for thirty years: Shania Twain's timeless vocals, with Zedd's genre-blending production, riding straight through Candy Country's glittering desert world.

"Bringing 'You're Still The One' back with Zedd, and building this special world with Candy Crush for fans to play in, felt like the perfect way to give the song new life. It feels exactly right," said Shania Twain.

"I was super happy Candy Crush brought me and Shania Twain together. She's a legendary artist, and I grew up listening to her music, so being able to collaborate with her on a new version of such an iconic song has been really special," said Zedd.

Last year, Candy Crush teamed up with Thundercat to reimagine a renowned Diana Ross track as a playable, swipe-driven music video. This year evolves that experience even further, turning a music video into an interactive hunt for hidden codes, surprises, and rewards. It's a natural evolution for a brand built around play, turning passive viewing into active discovery and creating new ways for fans to engage.

"Candy Crush has always been about making everyday moments more fun. Music Season takes that spirit into music culture, turning a song people know and love into something they can explore, play with and share. Working with Shania and Zedd gives fans a fresh experience and another way to experience Candy Crush beyond the game," said Luken Aragon, Chief Marketing Officer, King.

Music Season 2026 tournament is now live in-game through October 5, 2026, with the Music Season Expedition available from level 11 onward. Fans can also watch the video and start uncovering hidden rewards at candyroadhouse.com. Follow @candycrushsaga on Instagram and TikTok for live updates and Easter egg clues.

Candy Crush Saga® is free to download on iOS and Android. For more information, visit candycrushsaga.com.

*candyroadhouse.com rewards are available to U.S. residents only.

About Candy Crush Saga

Candy Crush Saga® is one of the world's most popular mobile games. Millions of players around the globe match colorful candies in combinations of three or more to win points, defeat obstacles, and progress through more than 20,000 levels. In November 2022, Candy Crush Saga celebrated its 10-year anniversary. Candy Crush Saga is available to download for free from the Apple App Store, Google Play, Amazon App Store, Windows App Store and Facebook.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world's most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

About Shania Twain

Shania Twain is a five-time GRAMMY Award-winning artist, songwriter, and performer who helped redefine country music for a global audience with her genre-blending, boundary-pushing sound. With seven studio albums and more than 100 million records sold worldwide, she remains the top-selling female country-pop artist of all time, behind era-defining hits like "You're Still The One," "Man! I Feel Like A Woman!," and "That Don't Impress Me Much." Her latest album, Little Miss Twain, blends country, pop, rock, soul, and Motown influences with collaborators including Tanya Tucker, Ronnie Wood, and Josh Homme. Beyond music, Twain is a fashion icon and philanthropist, supporting food insecurity, youth empowerment, and children's mental health through the Shania Twain Foundation. Learn more at shaniatwainfoundation.com.

About Zedd

Zedd is a multi-platinum, GRAMMY®-winning artist who's amassed 45 billion streams worldwide since his 2012 debut single "Clarity". His catalog includes RIAA platinum hits like "Stay" with Alessia Cara and "The Middle" with Maren Morris and Grey, alongside collaborators spanning John Mayer, Selena Gomez, and Ariana Grande. His most recent album, Telos, is GRAMMY-nominated and features Muse, Remi Wolf, and the late Jeff Buckley. Zedd's impressive discography has made an impact across all areas of entertainment. He has headlined festivals including Coachella and Lollapalooza, runs his own festival, Zedd in the Park, and has performed at the Super Bowl, the Emmys, and multiple NBA and NHL events. With over 5 million headlining tickets sold globally, he remains one of the most genre-defying artists of his generation.

releases.title: LEADING TIMES SQUARE BILLBOARDS TO UNITE TO OBSERVE ADVERTISING "MOMENT OF SILENCE" HONORING THE 25TH ANNIVERSARY OF 9/11
releases.body:
Times Square Media Companies Join 9/11 Day for Unprecedented 9:11 A.M. Tribute

NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On the morning of September 11, 2026, many of Times Square's iconic digital billboards will pause their normal advertising to participate in a special National Moment of Silence at 9:11 a.m. ET, marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.

The first-of-its-kind observance is being organized by the nonprofit 9/11 Day, with support from the Times Square Alliance and The Broadway League, along with support and participation from leading companies in the out-of-home advertising industry.

At 9:11 a.m., more than 30 participating Times Square displays will simultaneously feature a commemorative message during a one-minute Moment of Silence. Immediately afterward, singer Francesca "Ces" Picerno, who lost her father, Matthew Martin Picerno, in the terrorist attacks of 9/11, will join young performers from Broadway Bound Kids for a live rendition of "America the Beautiful."

9/11 Day Calls on Americans to "UNIITE For Good."

At the Moment of Silence observance, in Duffy Square, 9/11 Day will also unveil a 40-foot-long fully lit sculpture entitled "UNIITE." The sculpture, which was on display in Central Park on September 9, and at the Intrepid Museum on September 10, is part of 9/11 Day's nationwide 25th anniversary activities, encouraging Americans to remember and honor the victims of 9/11 and those who rose in service by joining together in unity and doing good deeds in their communities. For more information about how to pledge a good deed, visit 911day.org .

The Moment of Silence tribute has special personal meaning for Jay Winuk, who co-founded 9/11 Day in 2002 with his friend, David Paine. Jay's younger brother Glenn, an attorney and longtime volunteer firefighter and EMT, was killed in the line of duty in the collapse of the World Trade Center South Tower.

"As did so many first responders, my brother Glenn ran toward danger that morning to help people he didn't know, to serve his community," said Winuk, executive vice president of 9/11 Day. "Twenty-five years later, these few minutes of silence observed in the heart of Times Square is a simple but deeply meaningful act of remembrance for those we lost. I'm enormously grateful to the many participating companies and advertisers for making this possible."

"Our goal is to create a National Moment of Silence in America when our nation can take a moment to pause in remembrance of the 9/11 tragedy, and those impacted by it," said David Paine, co-founder and president of 9/11 Day. "We hope this will become an annual ritual over time."

9/11 Day's marketing partners, Innocean and David&Goliath, have led the way in securing the donated billboard commitments.

Among the media companies supporting the Times Square observance include (partial list as of the date of this news release): BIG Outdoor, Branded Cities, Clear Channel Outdoor, Del Mastro Outdoor, Dream Outdoor, Firefly, Heritage Outdoor, Intersection, KEVANI, Light Year Media,, New Tradition, Orange Barrel Media, OUTFRONT, Paramount, and Silvercast Media.

"Our industry has a unique ability to bring people together in shared public spaces," said Les Harrison of OUTFRONT Media, a leading IRL media company.  "On September 11, these physical screens can serve an even greater purpose — creating a moment when millions of people can pause together, remember and honor those whose lives were forever changed by 9/11."

About 9/11 Day

9/11 Day, a nonprofit, created and annually organizes the federally recognized September 11 National Day of Service and Remembrance. Founded in 2002 by David Paine and Jay Winuk, 9/11 Day works to transform the anniversary of 9/11 into a national day of doing good in tribute to those killed and injured in the attacks, and the many who rose in service in response. www.911day.org.

NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As pharmaceutical companies develop increasingly specialized treatments, marketers face a growing challenge: successfully reaching more precisely defined patient populations while navigating increasingly complex and competitive markets. Today, DeepIntent announced DeepIntent Cora™, the first fully agentic marketing platform built specifically for healthcare, designed to fundamentally transform how pharma companies strategize, collaborate and activate omnichannel marketing campaigns.

DeepIntent Cora brings agentic AI to healthcare marketing, enabling marketers to move rapidly from market intelligence to strategy with simple conversational language. Rather than requiring marketers to navigate multiple complex tools, data sets, and disconnected workflows, Cora brings these capabilities together in a single, simple, collaborative environment.

The need for a new approach is becoming increasingly urgent. More than 60% of drug treatments fail to meet their forecasted commercial goals, underscoring the difficulty of developing a clear path to commercial success. As pharma innovation increasingly shifts toward treatments for more specialized patient populations, the ability to identify, understand, and engage the right audiences with greater precision will become even more critical.

From fragmented hand-offs to an agentic marketing workflow

DeepIntent Cora is designed to transform the traditional pharma marketing workflow by bringing intelligence, data and execution together in a simple, agentic interface. Cora's capabilities include:

  • Conversational, agentic planning and execution. With Cora, marketers direct purpose-built agents with natural language to interrogate complex healthcare data, develop precise patient and healthcare provider audiences, and move from insight to activation without requiring advanced technical or programmatic expertise. In beta testing, Cora cut marketing planning time cycles by 50% with over 95% of customers reporting drastically faster workflows.
  • Omnichannel planning, audience building, and activation. For the first time, healthcare marketers will be able to forecast, plan, and activate audiences across channels within one platform – not just programmatic. New integrations, including VideoAmp for linear TV planning and forecasting, extend Cora's capabilities well beyond a traditional demand-side platform (DSP).
  • Real-time AI-driven intelligence. Cora continuously surfaces personalized, actionable insights across campaigns, competitors, clinical developments, market conditions, and media signals – helping to optimize campaigns more rapidly.
  • An expanded healthcare marketing cloud. Cora draws on DeepIntent Helix™, the industry's richest and most trusted healthcare marketing cloud. With this launch, Helix expands to incorporate new types of data, including payer and formulary signals, and richer diagnostic data, providing a broader foundation for planning, decision-making, and audience-building.
  • Collaborative human-and-AI workspaces. Cora introduces live, project-based workspaces that bring marketers, agencies, and AI agents together around a shared view of planning, activation, and optimization. Teams collaborate across brands and agencies and manage approvals and workflows, eliminating disconnected silos and handoffs.

"For over a decade, DeepIntent has built a platform with a singular focus on healthcare. With Cora, we are expanding beyond programmatic advertising and unlocking the value of agentic AI for strategy, planning, and activation across channels," said Chris Paquette, Founder and CEO, DeepIntent. "Just as drug development becomes more precise, Cora will break down siloes, helping our clients understand markets, collaborate more efficiently, and ultimately engage with patients and providers with unprecedented speed and confidence. In doing so, Cora will help pharma brands and their agencies bring more treatments to market successfully, while improving the quality of life for the patients they serve."

Cora is available today for all DeepIntent clients in an open beta. In a survey of 275 customers in a closed beta earlier this year, 95% reported drastically faster times conducting research, planning, and activating campaigns, with reported reductions of 50% or more in time.

releases.body:
New two-day interactive festival at Peoria Civic Center features a $50,000 Collegiate Esports Showdown, hands-on gaming and entertainment experiences, plus Future Play After Dark with Lil Jon and James Hype

PEORIA, Ill., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- This October, the future of entertainment is coming to Peoria — and audiences won't just watch it. They'll play it.

Future Play Festival, an all-new interactive gaming, esports, entertainment and technology experience, takes over the Peoria Civic Center October 3–4, 2026, bringing together competitive gaming, immersive attractions, creators, music and hands-on experiences for one action-packed weekend.

Unlike a traditional convention where attendees spend the day walking past exhibits, Future Play is built to be experienced.

Fans can step inside interactive attractions, compete and play, experience new technology, watch some of the country's top collegiate esports competitors battle live, meet creators, race RC cars, rediscover classic arcade games, experience live entertainment — and Saturday night, turn up with Lil Jon and James Hype at Future Play After Dark.

Tickets are on sale now, with festival admission starting at just $19.99.

"Future Play was created around a simple idea: don't just come and watch — come and play, compete and experience it for yourself," said Dylan Marer, Executive Producer at Cinematic, LLC., the producer of Future Play Festival. "We're bringing gaming, esports, immersive entertainment, technology and live music together under one roof to create a completely different kind of weekend experience. We want people to walk through the doors and continually discover something new."

$50,000 COLLEGIATE ESPORTS SHOWDOWN

At the center of Future Play will be the Future Play Collegiate Esports Showdown, where collegiate competitors will battle live for a $50,000 Rocket League prize pool.

The tournament brings the excitement of competitive collegiate esports out from behind the screen and onto the live stage, giving fans the opportunity to experience the speed, strategy and intensity of high-level Rocket League competition in person.

But the competition is only part of the experience.

THIS ISN'T JUST A SHOW. IT'S A PLAYGROUND.

Across the Peoria Civic Center, Future Play will give attendees an entire weekend of things to play, try, explore and experience, including:

  • Airsoft Tactical Shoot House Experience
  • EVIKE.com Airsoft Shooting Range
  • ARRMA RC Racing Experiences
  • Retro Arcade Gaming Lounge
  • Creator Studio
  • Immersive and emerging technology experiences
  • Live DJs and entertainment
  • Cosplay
  • Celebrity gaming appearances
  • Interactive gaming and brand activations
  • Future Play Collegiate Esports Showdown
  • And more experiences throughout the weekend

Whether you're a serious gamer, college student, esports fan, creator, tech enthusiast, music fan, parent introducing your kids to the games you grew up playing — or simply looking for something completely different to do — Future Play is designed to offer an experience for you.

"Most events stay in one lane," Marer said. "There are gaming conventions. There are esports tournaments. There are technology shows. And there are concerts. Future Play brings all of those worlds together and makes the audience part of the experience."

WHEN THE SUN GOES DOWN, FUTURE PLAY GOES AFTER DARK

The experience gets even bigger Saturday night.

On Saturday, October 3, Future Play transforms for Future Play After Dark, an explosive live music experience featuring hip-hop icon Lil Jon and global electronic music star James Hype.

From 8:00–11:30 p.m., the energy moves from the gaming floor to the concert experience as two internationally recognized artists bring Future Play's opening day to a high-energy finale.

Festival guests can choose from festival-only, concert-only and combination ticket options, making it possible to build their own Future Play weekend.

For fans looking for the complete experience, two-day festival + Future Play After Dark packages offer the best way to experience the entire weekend.

PEORIA BECOMES THE PLACE TO PLAY

Future Play is also part of a larger effort to establish Peoria as a Midwest destination for esports, emerging entertainment and next-generation live experiences.

"Peoria has been intentional in recruiting and investing in cutting-edge entertainment and event segments that bring world-class talent, new audiences and increased visitation to our region," said JD Dalfonso, CEO of Discover Peoria.

"One way we are doing this is by bolstering our efforts in esports and the entertainment opportunities that come with this rapidly growing industry. Future Play represents an exciting next step in that work. It will bring visitors from across the country to experience Peoria, while showcasing our community as a destination willing to embrace new ideas, new audiences and new forms of entertainment."

Dalfonso added, "We see this inaugural event as the beginning of something much bigger for esports, tourism and the region, and we are proud to be part of what comes next."

WASHINGTON, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcasters controlled by terrorist-designated organizations Hezbollah, Hamas, the Houthis and Kata'ib Hezbollah - collectively responsible for the deaths of hundreds of Americans - are being distributed to American households through illicit piracy streaming services, packaged alongside movies and live sports, according to an investigation by the Digital Citizens Alliance (DCA) and cybersecurity firm risk3sixty.
releases.title: U.S.-Sanctioned Terrorist Broadcasters Distributed on Piracy Platforms Reaching American Homes, Investigation Finds
releases.body:
Digital Citizens Alliance and risk3sixty find Hezbollah's Al-Manar, a U.S.-designated terrorist entity, bundled alongside movies and live sports on 17 of 25 illicit streaming services tested

WASHINGTON, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcasters controlled by terrorist-designated organizations Hezbollah, Hamas, the Houthis and Kata'ib Hezbollah - collectively responsible for the deaths of hundreds of Americans - are being distributed to American households through illicit piracy streaming services, packaged alongside movies and live sports, according to an investigation by the Digital Citizens Alliance (DCA) and cybersecurity firm risk3sixty.

Researchers found broadcasters affiliated with designated terrorist organizations or sanctioned foreign states on 17 of the 25 piracy platforms it examined. All were accessible over U.S. Internet connections. Al-Manar, Hezbollah's official broadcaster, was most prevalent, appearing on all 17 services carrying such programming. The State Department placed Al-Manar on the State Department's Terrorist Exclusion List in 2004 and the Treasury Department designated it as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist entity in March 2006.

The findings appear in a new report, Hostile Signals: How Illicit Piracy Platforms Give Terrorist-Controlled and Sanctioned Foreign Broadcasters Access to American Homes.

The joint investigation documents how piracy platforms provide organizations associated with terrorist organizations or other U.S. adversaries a commercial distribution system, operating outside U.S. law, that grants them access to paying American subscribers who never went looking for them. Access to the U.S. market is troubling considering the intelligence community's March 2026 assessment that Islamist terrorist groups have shifted toward information operations intended to spread propaganda and to inspire "lone wolf" attacks by individuals with access to the West.

"Piracy platforms give terrorist organizations a back door to access the U.S. market, circumventing two decades of efforts to keep these organizations from being able to broadcast into American homes," said Tom Galvin, Executive Director of the Digital Citizens Alliance.

"Our investigation found that piracy services routinely package terrorist-controlled broadcasters alongside everyday entertainment, creating a distribution channel that operates outside traditional safeguards. When extremist content is embedded in the same interface as sports, movies, and news, it becomes far less visible to those working to identify and disrupt radicalization efforts," said Steven Guris, threat intelligence lead at risk3sixty.

In the report, Digital Citizens and risk3sixty make three recommendations to lawmakers and law enforcement to address this national security threat:

  • Site-blocking Legislation. Site-blocking is a legal process to block access from the United States to foreign websites. While it's generally designed to combat infringers, it could address the problem of terrorist-linked broadcasters being distributed through piracy services by disrupting the piracy networks that carry their content. Legislation before Congress proposes a judicially supervised remedy aimed only at large-scale foreign piracy operations. While copyright owners drive the petition process, if the result is blocking piracy sites that carry the outlets of terrorist organizations, then site-blocking provides a national security benefit.



    In a September 2026 research survey of over 1,000 Americans, 65 percent supported allowing courts to order Internet providers to block access to foreign websites that distribute pirated content. Only 10 percent were opposed.
  • Treasury Sanctions Advisory. Treasury regularly issues sector-specific advisories alerting industries to sanctions exposure. An advisory directed at piracy operators, resellers, and the payment processors and hosting providers that serve them would put the industry on notice that carriage of Specially Designated Global Terrorist-owned broadcasters creates sanctions exposure.



  • Justice Department Domain Seizures. DOJ has seized domains for broadcasters owned or controlled by terrorist-designated organizations. Those cases were straightforward: a designated entity cannot obtain U.S. domain services without a Treasury Department license. Piracy platforms are harder. They aren't designated entities, so any case turns on what operators knew and kept carrying. But the predicate now exists - named services, named channels, confirmed U.S. access. DOJ should determine which operators fall within U.S. jurisdiction, put them and their registrars, hosts, and payment processors on formal notice, and seize where carriage continues afterward.

The full report is available at https://hostile-signals.digitalcitizensalliance.org/.

About Digital Citizens Alliance

The Digital Citizens Alliance is a nonprofit, 501(c)(6) organization that is a consumer-oriented coalition focused on educating the public and policymakers on the threats that consumers face on the Internet. Digital Citizens wants to create a dialogue on the importance for Internet stakeholders—individuals, government, and industry—to make the Web a safer place. Based in Washington, DC, the Digital Citizens Alliance counts among its supporters: private citizens, the health, pharmaceutical, and creative industries, as well as online safety experts and other communities focused on Internet safety. Learn more about Digital Citizens Alliance.

About risk3sixty

risk3sixty is an elite boutique cybersecurity firm headquartered in the greater Atlanta area, serving clients nationwide with continuous threat exposure management (CTEM), threat intelligence, and proactive security services through its Armada Proactive Services practice. Unlike software-only exposure management platforms that bury teams in unvalidated alerts, Armada embeds senior practitioners who run continuous threat intelligence, manually exploit findings to prove what's actually dangerous, and stay on every exposure until it's closed for good. In addition, risk3sixty offers a comprehensive suite of services for CISOs, including internal audit, compliance, and GRC program optimization.

Learn more about risk3sixty's proactive services at https://risk3sixty.com/secure

News Summary:

  • LG Electronics returns for the 78th Emmy® Awards Season as the Official TV and Appliance Partner of the Television Academy.
  • LG SIGNATURE makes its official Emmy Red Carpet debut by hosting the on-site "LG SIGNATURE Influencer Lounge" at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, featuring live creator content and LG products.

ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Continuing its official partnership with the Television Academy, LG Electronics USA returns for the 78th Emmy® Awards Season as the Official TV and Appliance Partner. Building on last year's successful collaboration with LG, this year's partnership expands across LG's appliances to bring together cutting-edge TV technology and the latest-premium LG SIGNATURE appliance brand to television's biggest night.

As part of the Television Academy's official corporate partner roster, LG Electronics will elevate the Emmy Awards experience for nominees, creators and fans through comprehensive home entertainment and appliance activations.

For the first time, LG Electronics is bringing a unified home entertainment and home appliance experience directly to the Emmys Red Carpet at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles by hosting the "LG SIGNATURE Influencer Lounge." Situated steps from arrivals, this dedicated branded space bridges cinematic technology and quiet luxury, featuring state-of-the-art LG displays streaming live coverage alongside showcases of the new Tailored Collection and LG SIGNATURE Steam Closet. Throughout the evening, curated lifestyle creators and LG Ambassadors in the lounge will capture real-time, behind-the-scenes content with arriving nominees and stars, while high-impact digital billboards at Los Angeles' iconic shopping destination, The Grove, extend the Emmys celebration across the city.

"LG Electronics is proud to continue our partnership with the Television Academy for the 78th Emmys season," said Louis Giagrande, Head of Marketing at LG Electronics USA. "This partnership reflects our shared passion for cinematic excellence, design, and storytelling. By uniting our award-winning TV technology with our premium LG SIGNATURE appliances, LG is uniquely positioned to deliver complete, elevated home experiences that inspire audiences everywhere."

Elevating Artistry Across Kitchen, Laundry, and Living

Marking its official debut on the Emmys Red Carpet this season, LG SIGNATURE is honored to partner with the Television Academy in celebrating a shared devotion to artistry, storytelling, and the moments that move audiences worldwide. Believing that the artistry celebrated on screen belongs in the spaces where life unfolds, LG SIGNATURE's latest evolution in premium kitchen and laundry appliances brings a quiet luxury aesthetic into the home. Designed with pioneering touches that feel instantly familiar, these innovations are showcased across three new LG SIGNATURE collections (Iconic, Seamless, and Tailored), reflecting the belief that the best design, like the best storytelling, is felt long before it is noticed.

"We are delighted to expand our relationship with LG Electronics for the 78th Emmy Awards season," said Maury McIntyre, President and CEO of the Television Academy. "LG brings industry-leading technology to all its products, embodying the spirit of innovation and artistry that we celebrate on television's biggest night. We look forward to elevating how audiences experience the magic of television together."

Nationwide and International Consumer and Smart TV Integrations

To further enhance the Emmys season experience for consumers, LG is featuring a curated hub within LG Channels and webOS. The feature will bring together a curated selection of Emmy Award-winning and nominated content for LG TV owners, including SNL Vault, The Walking Dead Universe, Law & Order, The Price is Right, Family Feud, and more1.

This partnership will also tie into LG's consumer promotions during Streaming Week2 and feature high-impact billboard activations in New York's Times Square and London, alongside retail promotions across the U.S., giving LG owners access to exclusive deals from top streaming partners and making it easier than ever to enjoy their favorite Emmy-nominated shows and movies. In the UK, LG Channels will carry the Emmys live, while LG Nordics will offer the ceremony on demand.

The 78th Emmy Awards will telecast live from the Peacock Theater at L.A. LIVE in Los Angeles on Monday, Sept. 14, 2026, airing coast-to-coast on NBC and streaming live on Peacock at 8 p.m. ET/5p.m. PT.

To learn more about LG Electronics' award-winning TVs, LG SIGNATURE collections, and home innovations, visit www.lg.com.

Across every booth, iodyne will showcase how their storage solutions move high-resolution footage through workflows without slowing down, staying encrypted and RAID-protected the entire way.

Powering the Show Floor

iodyne's presence at IBC2026 spans four partner booths, each showcasing encrypted, RAID-protected data moving from capture through color, ingest, and archive without a hitch. Here's where to find it on the show floor:

  • Hedge (Booth 7.A36): Hedge is running iodyne storage across a full capture-to-archive pipeline on its booth, pairing Hedge's OffShoot, Canister, EditReady, Canopy, Mimiq with iodyne Pro Data and Pro Mini to show attendees a verified, encrypted transfer at every step, from the initial offload off camera media through to long-term archive.



  • Adobe (Booths 13.D501, 7.B35): iodyne is showing up across multiple Adobe workflows this year, from Premiere to After Effects, including native-resolution RAW grading inside the new Color Mode in Premiere, an integration first detailed in iodyne's Premiere Color Mode workflow story. iodyne will also publish a new episode of its Workflow Kitchen series featuring Dave Helmly from Adobe, covering the AI-driven features Adobe has released over the past year and how they fit into faster color and post pipelines.



  • RED Digital Cinema (Booth 11.C35): At the RED Digital Cinema booth, iodyne Pro Data will support live, fast, and secure R3D RAW workflows, building on the streamlined card-free ingest setup that the two companies showed earlier this year at NAB Show and Cinegear Expo.



  • Cintegral Technologies (Booth 1.D25): iodyne rental partner, Cintegral Technologies, is making its IBC debut focused on connectivity services for the European market, including private 5G and free-space optical (FSO) transmission for productions that need to move data without a fixed line. As it expands into connectivity, Cintegral says the Pro Mini remains central to its business.

"For me, what makes the Pro Mini so invaluable to us as a business is the intersectionality it provides across all our verticals," said Dane Brehm, Production Technologist of Cintegral Technologies.

"Having the Pro Mini as a premium product when people know us for our storage-as-a-service gives us the opportunity to interest them in our other offerings, like the connectivity we're showcasing for IBC. Utilizing a premium product in an excellent partnership builds trust and creates Cintegral's secret sauce for success."

Getting studio-grade data workflows into the field is a business imperative across sports, cinema and TV. iodyne points to its case study with the Dallas Cowboys on off-site content production, alongside a new case study with CineLab, as examples of that shift. iodyne invites IBC attendees to stop by any of its partner booths to talk through how the same edge workflows could apply to their own productions.

iodyne's drives remain the fastest in the storage category while staying fully encrypted and RAID-protected—a standard the company calls TruePut. At IBC2026, iodyne puts its drives to work, demoing how faster encrypted transfer speeds cut down both the time spent offloading footage in the field and the cost of shipping physical drives back to a home base.

For more information, visit iodyne.com.

About iodyne

Founded by veteran enterprise storage engineers, iodyne builds encrypted, RAID-protected storage for professionals who work at the edge, in the field, on set, or anywhere else a slow or fragile drive isn't an option. Its Pro Data and Pro Mini product lines pair hardware RAID-6 and XTS-AES-256 encryption with the sustained, verified performance the company calls TruePut, giving media and entertainment, government, and enterprise IT teams a way to move and protect large datasets without giving up speed. iodyne is based in Los Angeles. releases.title: IAB Raises 2026 U.S. Ad Spend Forecast to +12.3% YoY Growth, as Strong First Half Lifts Expectations
releases.body:
As AI Reshapes How Consumers Discover and Choose Brands, Advertisers Prioritize Customer Acquisition, Brand Equity and Visibility in AI-driven Discovery

NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), the leading trade organization for the digital advertising ecosystem, today released its 2026 Outlook Study: September Update, raising its full-year U.S. ad spend growth forecast to 12.3%, up 2.8 percentage points from its January projection of 9.5%.

Based on insights from more than 200 brand and agency ad investment decision-makers, the updated forecast follows a stronger-than-expected first half fueled by major cyclical events, including the Winter Olympics and FIFA World Cup, along with easing buyer concerns about macroeconomic headwinds. The study also finds marketers prioritizing customer acquisition and brand equity as consumers become more discerning and AI transforms how people discover, evaluate, and choose brands.

"The first half was strong, major live events delivered, and advertisers have increasingly powerful tools in their arsenal to find and engage customers," said David Cohen, CEO, IAB. "At the same time, the economy has real areas of uncertainty. There is growth to be found, but there are no easy wins. When consumers are considering their next purchase, the brands that win will be connecting with them at the right time, in the right context, and with a compelling message."

Marketers Shift Their Focus to Winning New Customers

The updated outlook shows a clear shift in what advertisers want their media investments to accomplish. Customer acquisition, although usually the top media investment goal, jumped nine percentage points since January to 63%, while brand equity rose six points to 43%. Meanwhile, repeat purchases held essentially flat at 24%, after nearly doubling as a priority since 2024.

The change comes as consumers face persistent inflation and cautious sentiment, making shoppers more selective about where their money goes and more willing to switch brands and retailers. For advertisers, that creates both a need to reinforce brand strength and an opportunity to win undecided customers.

"Consumers are becoming more discerning. They're switching brands, paying for lower-priced brands and looking at store brands," said Chris Bruderle, Vice President, Industry Insights & Content Strategy, IAB. "For brands, that means two things. They need to make sure their brand equity is strong, particularly in AI environments. And if people are more willing to switch brands, there's an opportunity to acquire new customers."

Marketers Concerned About LLM Discovery and AI Slop

Marketers are increasingly focused on the consumer using AI platforms and what that means for discovery, consideration, and purchase.

Adapting to evolving consumer behavior, including AI-driven search, is now the top media investment challenge, cited by 44% of buyers. Concern about low-quality AI-generated content, or "AI slop," follows at 38%.

At the same time, optimizing content for AI-generated answers is now the No. 1 area of increased focus among buyers at 76%, followed by AI LLM models at 72%. Focus on generative AI use in media campaigns stands at 69%, compared with 78% in January.

"What we are seeing is a pretty meaningful evolution in the AI conversation," said Brudele. "Marketers have spent a lot of time asking, 'How can I use AI?' Now the question is becoming, 'How do I reach a consumer who uses AI?' People are discovering products and evaluating brands inside these environments. Marketers want to understand how their brands show up in those conversations and how that activity connects to everything else they know about the customer journey."

AI Is Changing the Consumer Journey Faster Than Marketers Can Measure It

That shift is creating a major measurement challenge, with 86% of buyers already changing, or expecting to change, how they measure media performance because of conversational AI tools and AI agents in the next 12 months.

The most common response, selected by 48% of buyers, is measuring brand visibility and citations directly within AI tools. Others are using branded search and direct traffic as proxies, adding third-party AI discovery analysis tools, monitoring AI-platform interactions and referrals, and increasing incrementality testing.

Yet buyers still struggle to connect those signals into a complete view of performance, with 45% citing the difficulty of comparing AI-driven and traditional customer journeys as their top measurement challenge.

"There are important conversations about brands and products happening inside AI environments every day, and marketers are still building the visibility they need into that journey," said Bruderle. "They know the consumer is there. They know these experiences can influence a purchase. Now they are figuring out how to connect those interactions to the signals and outcomes they have measured for years."

A New Playbook for Winning Attention

As audiences fragment across traditional search, conversational AI, commerce platforms, social media, and other discovery environments, advertisers are also changing how they reach consumers. The ad types receiving the most increased focus are:

  • Creator and influencer advertising/partnerships: 54%
  • Demo-targeted and cohort-based advertising: 53%
  • Publishers with first-party data: 48%
  • Contextual advertising: 45%

Together, those priorities point to a broader effort to build trust, identify valuable audiences, and stay visible as consumer discovery becomes more fragmented.

"The pieces really do connect," said Bruderle. "If consumers are moving across more places to discover products, marketers have to think differently about how they earn trust, how they identify the right audiences, and how their content gets found. Visibility is becoming part of the media strategy in a much broader way. It includes the creator someone trusts, the environment where an ad appears, and increasingly what an AI platform says when someone asks about your category or your brand."

The Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) empowers the media and marketing industries to thrive in the digital economy. Its membership comprises more than 700 leading media companies, brands, agencies, and the technology firms responsible for selling, delivering, and optimizing digital ad marketing campaigns. The trade group fields critical research on interactive advertising, while also educating brands, agencies, and the wider business community on the importance of digital marketing. In affiliation with the IAB Tech Lab, IAB develops technical standards and solutions. IAB is committed to professional development and elevating the knowledge, skills, expertise, and collaboration of the workforce across the industry. Through the work of its public policy office in Washington, D.C., the trade association advocates for its members and promotes the value of the interactive advertising industry to legislators and policymakers. Founded in 1996, IAB is headquartered in New York City.

WASHINGTON, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The White House Historical Association today released a new episode of The White House 1600 Sessions podcast marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks through firsthand accounts from three people who experienced the fateful day from inside the White House and alongside President George W. releases.title: NEW Episode: The White House 1600 Sessions Podcast "Inside the White House on September 11"
releases.body:
White House Historical Association President

Stewart McLaurin Reflects on September 11, 2001,

25 Years Later with Former ABC News White House Correspondent Ann Compton,

Longtime White House Chief Usher Gary Walters, and Former Special Assistant to

President George W. Bush Anita McBride

WASHINGTON, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The White House Historical Association today released a new episode of The White House 1600 Sessions podcast marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks through firsthand accounts from three people who experienced the fateful day from inside the White House and alongside President George W. Bush.

President of the White House Historical Association, Stewart McLaurin sits down with former ABC News White House correspondent Ann Compton; Gary Walters, the longtime White House chief usher; and Anita McBride, then special assistant to President George W. Bush. Their first-person accounts offer a rare look inside the White House on September 11 and preserve these important memories for future generations.

President George W. Bush began that morning at an elementary school in Sarasota, Florida. Within minutes, he was leading the nation through one of the gravest crises in its history. As officials rushed him aboard Air Force One, White House staff evacuated the complex amid reports that another hijacked aircraft could be heading toward Washington. Throughout the day, those at the White House worked to maintain continuity of government while preparing for the president's return.

After evacuating the White House, McBride details how she led her colleagues to a nearby office building so White House staff could have access to the technology they needed to continue working and supporting the Executive Mansion.

Gary Walters details how he remained at the White House to prepare for the President's return as South Lawn was set up for a picnic and needed to be cleared for Marine One to land upon the President's arrival home.

"Six of us got around the picnic tables and picked them up one by one and carried them over to the roadway and stacked them one on top of the other," said Walters. "We also had to take up the floor of the stage, everything that was moveable had to go. It was a massive undertaking and exhausting, but the exhilaration and the adrenaline was flowing in everybody."

Ann Compton recounts her experience as a member of the press pool travelling with the president.  From Florida to Louisiana, Nebraska, and ultimately back to Washington, D.C., she witnessed the president's movements firsthand and offered unique insight into his response and actions on September 11.

"While the president was listening to the children, I suddenly saw Andy Card, the White House Chief of Staff, come quickly in, lean over, whisper to the president, and quickly step back again. What stunned me was the look on the president's face," said Compton. "He had been president for less than nine months, and I had never seen President Bush with a look of such gravity, iron gravity in his eyes."

McLaurin, Compton, McBride, and Walters also reflect on the leadership, humanity, and national unity that emerged from one of the darkest days in American history. They also discuss the importance of preserving these firsthand memories for generations with no living memory of September 11.

"Political affiliations seemed to fade away," said McLaurin. "I remember so vividly, Congress on the steps of the Capitol that night singing together, united, and the president going to New York in the subsequent days."

"People banded together," said McBride. "That's the message of September 11, the humanity and the unity that we felt in our darkest hour, and that's what defines who we are as an American people."

The White House 1600 Sessions podcast is available on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

The full video of this podcast episode is also available on the White House Historical Association's YouTube channel here.

The White House 1600 Sessions 

The White House Historical Association's President Stewart McLaurin is the host of The White House 1600 Sessions, the Association's official audio and video podcast devoted to exploring the history, cultural impact, untold stories, and personal accounts of America's most iconic residence and highest office.

About the White House Historical Association 

Founded in 1961 by First Lady Jacqueline Kennedy, the White House Historical Association is the nonprofit, nonpartisan organization entrusted with preserving and sharing the history of the White House. Supported entirely by private philanthropy and the sale of educational books and products, the Association reaches millions of students, teachers, and lifelong learners through research and scholarship initiatives, public programming, and the authoritative titles published by its independent press. Throughout each presidency, the Association works with the Offices of the First Lady and the White House Curator to acquire and preserve historic objects for the White House Fine and Decorative Arts Collection. The Association also operates The People's House: A White House Experience, a free, immersive, educational museum in Washington, D.C., which welcomes hundreds of thousands of visitors annually. To learn more about the White House Historical Association, please visit WhiteHouseHistory.org.

releases.title: MANN ROBINSON EXPANDS ENTERTAINMENT ECOSYSTEM WITH 'URBAN OPERAS', A NEW VERTICAL STREAMING PLATFORM BUILT FOR STORIES THAT KNOW US
releases.body:
Urban Operas will launch with 15 original micro dramas produced by Robinson and his production team, while creating a new streaming destination for independent vertical filmmakers

ATLANTA, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Filmmaker, director, producer, studio owner, distributor, and streaming entrepreneur Mann Robinson is expanding his growing entertainment ecosystem with the launch of Urban Operas, a new vertical streaming platform created to bring culturally connected, mobile first storytelling directly to audiences.

Built around the tagline, "Stories That Know Us", Urban Operas will feature serialized dramas created specifically for mobile viewing, with short, fast moving episodes built around compelling characters, emotional storytelling, cliffhangers, relationships, romance, crime, family, betrayal, ambition, money, power, and the experiences of audiences that Robinson believes remain underserved within the rapidly expanding vertical entertainment marketplace.

Urban Operas is not being created in opposition to the major companies already operating in the vertical entertainment space. Instead, he sees this as an opportunity to expand the marketplace by creating a platform with a specific cultural identity and programming philosophy. When speaking of what makes Urban Operas unique, Robinson says, "The major platforms have their audiences and the types of programming that make sense for their businesses. I respect that. I saw an opportunity to build something from our perspective. There should be a destination where our stories aren't simply another category somewhere inside the platform. They are the foundation of the platform. That's what Urban Operas is being built to become. Original content will remain at the center of Urban Operas."

Independent filmmakers can find submission details through the official Urban Operas website at www.urbanoperas.com. Selected outside productions will have the opportunity to be distributed through Urban Operas under a creator focused revenue share model, allowing qualified filmmakers and content owners to participate financially in the performance of their programming on the platform.

Urban Operas will begin appearing on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store in November 2026, with its official launch scheduled for Winter 2026.

ABOUT MANN ROBINSON

Mann Robinson has produced and directed more than 30 film and television projects and has built an independent entertainment operation spanning film and television production, content distribution, production equipment, marketing, props and production resources, and direct to consumer streaming.

releases.title: FlexFactor Named Finalist in Six Categories at The Card & Payments Awards US 2026
releases.body:
Recognition across six categories highlights FlexFactor's AI-native approach to reversing eligible false declines during authorization

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlexFactor, the payments technology company behind AI-native AcceptIQ, has been named a finalist in six categories at The Card & Payments Awards US 2026. Based on FlexFactor's review of the published 2026 shortlist, FlexFactor is the only organization with six finalist selections.

                                               

FlexFactor has been shortlisted for:

  • Best Application of AI or ML in Financial Services
  • Best Customer Service
  • Best Early-Stage or Future Payments Initiative
  • Best Industry Innovation
  • Best Payment Facility
  • Best POS Solution

These six selections span distinct areas of the payments ecosystem – from artificial intelligence and customer experience to future payments, industry innovation, payment infrastructure, and point-of-sale technology.

FlexFactor's Approach – Creating a New Decisioning Layer Inside Payment Authorization

Historically, payment technologies have largely operated on either side of authorization. Fraud, risk, and authentication technologies evaluate transactions before issuer response, while retries, dunning, and account updater solutions attempt recovery after a payment has already failed. FlexFactor created real-time decline decisioning to bridge this structural gap.

At the center of the capability is AcceptIQ, FlexFactor's AI-native platform for real-time payment decline decisioning. AcceptIQ evaluates transaction, issuer, merchant, data-quality, acquiring, and routing signals to determine whether a decline is recoverable, the likelihood of successful reauthorization, and the appropriate recovery path.

When AcceptIQ identifies an eligible false decline, FlexFactor can execute the recovery, purchase the merchant's invoice, guarantee the sale, and assume the recovery risk. This enables eligible false payment declines to be reversed before they become lost sales, wasted customer acquisition spend, lost lifetime value, or damaging customer experiences.

For the end customer, the recovery is invisible. Legitimate customers can complete their intended purchase without retrying the transaction, changing payment methods, or entering a separate recovery journey.

FlexFactor is live with more than 100 merchants and typically cures 15% to 20% of eligible declines across live deployments, with observed results varying by merchant profile, decline mix, and payment environment.

"Reversing a failed payment after it has already been declined by some of the world's most sophisticated payment systems is not a simple problem. Doing it in real time makes it even harder," said Guy Vatman, CTO of FlexFactor. "It requires evaluating multiple signals and determining the right recovery path within the authorization flow before that failed-payment experience reaches the customer. To solve that challenge, we built AcceptIQ, which creates real value for the payments ecosystem – enabling merchants to preserve legitimate sales as customers complete their purchase without even knowing a decline occurred."

A Word From The Card & Payments Awards

"For more than 20 years, The Card & Payments Awards have been about recognizing the organizations and people raising standards across the payments ecosystem. As we bring the Awards to the United States for the first time, the quality and breadth of this year's shortlist demonstrates the extraordinary level of innovation taking place across the industry. Being shortlisted is an achievement in itself. To be recognized across six categories is a significant result for FlexFactor and reflects the breadth of the work presented to our independent judging panel. We look forward to welcoming FlexFactor, alongside our wider finalist community, to Gotham Hall in New York on November 17." – Michael Harty, Founder & Managing Director, The Card & Payments Awards

The Card & Payments Awards US 2026

Established in 2005, The Card & Payments Awards recognizes excellence, innovation, and best practice across the payments industry. In 2026, the Awards bring their independent judging process and industry community to the United States for the inaugural US event.

The winners of The Card & Payments Awards US 2026 will be announced on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at Gotham Hall, New York. The evening begins at 6 pm and continues until late.

Event – The Card & Payments Awards US 2026
Date – November 17, 2026
Venue – Gotham Hall, New York
Prime Sponsor – FIS

About FlexFactor

FlexFactor is a payments technology company transforming payment decline recovery through real-time decline decisioning during authorization. Its AI-native AcceptIQ platform identifies, evaluates, and reverses eligible false payment declines before customers experience a failed payment – helping merchants prevent legitimate transactions from becoming lost sales, wasted customer acquisition spend, lost lifetime value, and damaging customer experiences. FlexFactor supports one-time, recurring, and hybrid commerce through existing payment infrastructure, enabling merchants to improve payment performance without adding friction to checkout. FlexFactor is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

About The Card & Payments Awards

Since 2005, The Card & Payments Awards has recognized excellence and innovation across the global payments ecosystem. The Awards are built around an independent judging process and bring together organizations shaping the future of payments. The inaugural US Awards create a new platform to recognize the companies, technologies, partnerships, and people advancing payments across the United States.

releases.title: Omnicom Advertising Announces Leadership Transition
releases.body:
Troy Ruhanen to Retire; Andrew Robertson Appointed CEO of Omnicom Advertising

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), the world's leading marketing and sales company, today announced that Troy Ruhanen, President and Chief Executive Officer of Omnicom Advertising, has decided to retire following a distinguished career spanning more than twenty years in leadership roles across Omnicom. Ruhanen's decision follows the successful integration of Omnicom Advertising after the combination of Omnicom and Interpublic, which established a strong foundation for the future.

"Troy has been an exceptional leader whose impact on Omnicom and our industry cannot be overstated. His leadership was instrumental in bringing together our combined organization while strengthening our ability to serve clients and create opportunities for our people. We are grateful for his many contributions and wish him every success in retirement," said John Wren, Chairman and CEO of Omnicom.

Andrew Robertson, currently Chairman of BBDO Worldwide, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer of Omnicom Advertising, effective immediately. Having spent more than two decades as a leader within Omnicom, Robertson brings valuable expertise, long-standing client relationships with marquee global brands, and a demonstrated track record of building high-performing teams. He will work closely with Ruhanen during the transition to ensure a seamless hand-off.

"Andrew is a proven leader with a deep understanding of Omnicom, our clients, and our industry. I look forward to working with him on the continued development of our advertising group, particularly his commitment to ensuring creativity remains at the core of what we do as we advance our AI and technology capabilities," added Wren.

Omnicom Advertising continues to set industry benchmarks, recently welcoming Subway, American Express, and BBVA as new clients while all three of its creative networks ranked in the top 10 at Cannes Lions this year. Its visionary client work has allowed Omnicom to be recognized as the World's Most Effective Holding Group in the Effie Index for three years in a row, and its agencies have consistently been recognized by Fast Company as among the Most Innovative Companies for the past eight years.

"It has been the privilege of a lifetime to work alongside some of the most talented people in our industry. I am incredibly proud of what we have accomplished together. With the integration complete, this is the right moment for me to retire. I have profound confidence in Andrew and our leadership team," said Ruhanen.

"Our plan is clear," said Robertson. "Secure a disproportionate share of the world's most exciting creative and strategic minds, equip them - through Omni - with the industry's most advanced AI enabled tools and data, to deliver exceptional results for a client list that is the envy of our competitors."

About Omnicom Advertising

Omnicom Advertising (OA), the creative agency services capability of Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), aligns leading creative networks; BBDO, McCann and TBWA with creative boutiques such as Goodby, Silverstein & Partners, Deutsch, GSD&M and MARTIN, among others. By bringing these agency brands under one leadership, OA allows them to leverage their collective strength today and tomorrow, to deliver the best, most impactful, creative experiences in the industry. This new connected capability unites more than 20,000 creative minds around the globe on a mission to build distinction for almost two thirds of the world's biggest brands (Interbrand, Best Global Brands 2025). 

About Omnicom

Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) is the world's leading marketing and sales company, built for intelligent growth in the next era. Powered by Omni and its proprietary data and identity, Omnicom's Connected Capabilities unite the company's world‑class agency brands, exceptional talent, and deep domain expertise across media, commerce, consulting, precision marketing, advertising, production, health, public relations, branding, and experiential to address clients' most critical growth priorities. For more information, visit www.omc.com.

releases.title: Magic EdTech Introduces ezSuite™, an AI-Native Content Solution to Transform Modern Publishing
releases.body:
ezSuite™ helps publishers and institutions move beyond print-first workflows with modular content, AI-enabled productivity, and governed publishing operations.

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- Magic EdTech announced ezSuite™, its AI-native content operations solution designed to address the barriers publishers and institutions face in creating, managing, updating, and delivering content at scale. For organizations navigating fragmented systems and manual workflows, ezSuite™ brings greater speed, control, reuse, and transparency across the content lifecycle.

ezSuite™ replaces traditional, format-locked content production processes with a unified ecosystem. Instead of treating books, assessments, media, and derivative assets as disconnected outputs, ezSuite™ creates a component-based source of truth that supports modular authoring, synchronized updates, and multi-channel publishing.

The solution makes learning assets easier to discover, reuse, and update through structured metadata and version control, supporting personalized and adaptive learning pathways that respond to learner needs.

For edtech, this means faster revision cycles, lower operational friction, and an agile path from content creation to delivery. Once content is modularized, updates to core learning objects can automatically identify related assessments, resources, media, metadata, and supplements for review. This synchronized workflow helps teams maintain accuracy across large portfolios.

ezSuite™ combines AI and automation with strong editorial governance. It follows a human-in-the-loop model where output remains reviewable before release. Full audit trails source inputs, reviewer decisions, and final outputs, maintaining quality, compliance, and academic rigor.

For greater data privacy and ownership, ezSuite™ can be deployed within its own managed infrastructure, with customer content and outputs not used to train foundation models.

"Through ezSuite™, we are fundamentally redefining the content lifecycle, shifting the industry toward a unified, AI-native ecosystem where structured content serves as the single source of truth," said Sanjay Kabra, COO of Magic EdTech. "By integrating agentic AI with rigorous editorial governance, ezSuite™ empowers publishers to transform assets into dynamic, continuously evolving learning experiences that scale effortlessly."

Beyond operational efficiency, ezSuite™ opens new opportunities for portfolio expansion. Publishers can create new product variants, localized editions, adaptive learning experiences, multilingual content, multimedia formats, and personalized learning paths from the same trusted foundation.

ezSuite™ is now available. Learn more here.

releases.title: Frameo Ranked Number 1 AI Filmmaking Agent in Independent Physion Labs Benchmark
releases.body:
Dashverse's AI storytelling agent Frameo outperformed 8 leading AI filmmaking agents, scoring 88.7, nearly 20 points ahead of the runner-up and ranking first across Narrative Coherence, Cinematic Language and Production Quality.

  • Frameo ranked #1 on 13 of 16 metrics, including all 8 human-preference metrics, in a 100-prompt, 800-video human evaluation.

SAN FRANCISCO and BENGALURU, India, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- Dashverse today announced that Frameo, its AI filmmaking and video generation agent, ranked #1 in Arc v1.0 Movie, an independent benchmark published by Physion Labs. In a human evaluation of 8 AI video agents, including Runway Agent 2.0, Luma Creative Agents, Kling Canvas Agent, and Invideo Agent One, Frameo scored 88.7 out of 100 on quality, nearly twenty points clear of the second-placed agent.

"The margin was large enough that it caught us by surprise. We ran a round of validation and brought in a fourth expert reviewer. The conclusion held: the results are valid, and Frameo is meaningfully ahead of every other agent that we evaluated," said Qin Zhang, Founder and CEO of Physion Labs.

Frameo was not built to win filmmaking benchmarks

Dashverse Co-Founder and CTO Soumyadeep Mukherjee built Frameo as the production system behind the company's AI short dramas that consumers pay to watch.

"We never optimized Frameo for movies. We built it for short dramas that audiences pay for, so the #1 result surprised us too," said Soumyadeep Mukherjee, CTO of Dashverse. "The benchmark has opened up a whole new world of possibilities, from ads to films. We're already seeing studios, brands, and creators reach out to explore what they can create with Frameo."

From short dramas to film, television, and marketing

Following these results, Dashverse is expanding Frameo beyond short dramas into film, television, and marketing. The company will work with studios, OTTs and brands, combining Frameo with trained Dashverse artists via its Forward Deployed Artist (FDA) model.

"The benchmark showed us that the system we built to run our own shows is now one of the strongest AI filmmaking systems in the world," said Sanidhya Narain, CEO of Dashverse.

releases.title: From Classrooms to Festival Stages: Toyota and Music Will Empower the Next Generation of Artists
releases.body:
Toyota Donates $75,000 and Provides Students with Real-World Festival Experiences

PLANO, Texas, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Music has the power to inspire creativity, build confidence and strengthen communities. Through its continued partnership with Music Will, the nation's largest nonprofit music education program, Toyota is helping bring those opportunities to more students through a $75,000 donation and a series of unforgettable real-world experiences that connect them beyond the classroom.

Experience the full interactive Multichannel News Release here: https://www.multivu.com/conill_toyota/9419551-en-toyota-music-will-nonprofit-music-education-program-partnership

This year, Toyota and Music Will partnered through the Driving Music Forward initiative, a purpose-driven program designed to support music education, uplift diverse voices and inspire the next generation of artists through authentic, real-world opportunities. The initiative brings together Toyota's music platform, nonprofit partnerships and festival activations under a unified effort focused on community impact through music.

"Organizations like Music Will demonstrate the powerful role music plays in education and community engagement," said Paul Doleshal, general manager, motorsports and sponsorships, Toyota. "Through this initiative, we're connecting purpose-driven storytelling with tangible action, creating opportunities that allow students to perform and grow. Whether it's a classroom experience or a performance on a festival stage, we are proud to support programs that make a measurable difference in young people's lives."

The $75,000 donation will support music education programs in communities connected to Music Will and Toyota's music activations, helping ensure students have access to the instruments, resources and opportunities needed to develop their talents. Toyota's partnership with Music Will extends beyond financial support by creating meaningful experiences that help students see what's possible through music.

"As we enter year two of our partnership, Toyota's continued commitment is making a profound impact on modern music programs in public school classrooms nationwide," said Janice Polizzotto, Chief Growth Officer, Music Will. "By pairing this ongoing support with once-in-a-lifetime, real-world festival opportunities, we're giving students an unforgettable platform for creativity, confidence, and self-expression. Together, we're helping youth thrive by showing them that their passion and potential truly matter."

Throughout the year, students participating in Music Will programs experienced some of the nation's biggest festivals, performing on the Toyota Music Den stage, including Sueños Music Festival in Chicago, Roots Picnic in Philadelphia, Lollapalooza in Chicago and Head In The Clouds in Los Angeles. These performances gave students invaluable exposure to live audiences and the unique experience of participating in nationally recognized music festivals.

By providing students the opportunity to showcase their talent, Toyota is helping bridge the gap between education and opportunity while celebrating the cultural expression that music makes possible. The initiative aligns with Toyota's broader commitment to creating positive community impact through programs that empower future generations and foster meaningful connections through shared experiences.

About Toyota 

Toyota (NYSE:TM) has been a part of the cultural fabric in the North America for nearly 70 years, and is committed to advancing sustainable, next-generation mobility through our Toyota and Lexus brands, plus our nearly 1,800 dealerships. 

Toyota directly employs nearly 64,000 people in North America who have contributed to the design, engineering, and assembly of more than 50 million cars and trucks at our 14 manufacturing plants. In 2025, Toyota's plant in North Carolina began to assemble automotive batteries for electrified vehicles.

For more information about Toyota, visit www.ToyotaNewsroom.com.

About Music Will

Music Will's mission is to transform lives by transforming music education. Through its innovative modern band curriculum, Music Will expands student participation in school music programs and helps drive long-term academic, social, and emotional growth. Since 2002, the organization has provided teacher training, curriculum, and instruments to over 6,000 schools across all 50 states, reaching more than 1.8 million students to date.

The program's roots go back to 1996, when a classroom teacher in East Palo Alto, CA, began offering free guitar lessons to his students to fill the gap left by the absence of a music program at his school. What started in one elementary classroom has since grown into a national movement, expanding to more than 1,000 school districts nationwide. By 2030, Music Will aims to reach 11 million students annually through its nationally scaled programming.
