releases.body:
IQSTEL has launched the IDILIO TV commercial sales pipeline with mobile operators as part of its strategy to build scalable, high-margin recurring digital revenue

IDILIO TV is backed by a $5 million seed round led by a16z Speedrun, with Goodwater Capital, WndrCo and Nubank founder David Vélez participating

NEW YORK, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) today announced a corporate objective to establish mobile-operator distribution channels capable of reaching a potential audience of approximately 40 million mobile users by the end of the second quarter of 2027 for the microdrama entertainment service offered through its strategic partnership with IDILIO TV.

The initiative is built directly on infrastructure IQSTEL already owns. The Company maintains commercial relationships with more than 600 telecommunications operators across 24 countries, whose networks collectively provide potential access to approximately 2.3 billion end users. Those relationships were established to carry voice, SMS and data traffic. IQSTEL now intends to use the same commercial channel as a distribution pipeline for premium digital content — creating a route to monetize an existing platform in higher-margin, recurring-revenue services.

The Company's 40 million-user objective refers to the combined potential audience represented by the mobile operators it targets for distribution agreements. It does not represent 40 million existing or guaranteed paying subscribers.

From Network Operator to Content Distribution Platform

IQSTEL spent years building a multinational telecommunications footprint: interconnection agreements, technical integrations, billing relationships and commercial trust with carriers on five continents. That footprint has historically been monetized through wholesale voice and messaging — high-volume, low-margin businesses in which IQSTEL competes on scale and execution.

The IDILIO TV partnership is intended to demonstrate a different use for the same asset. A carrier relationship that can terminate SMS traffic can also bundle, market and bill for a subscription entertainment service. IQSTEL's existing operator integrations, commercial relationships and billing rails are expected to support the distribution and billing capabilities required to commercialize the service. What changes is the product moving across that infrastructure — and the potential margin profile associated with it.

"This initiative demonstrates how IQSTEL can transform the global telecommunications platform we have built over many years into a commercialization engine for higher-margin digital products," said Leandro Iglesias, CEO of IQSTEL. "We are combining an attractive product, experienced digital leadership and established operator relationships. Together, these elements can create a powerful foundation for recurring revenue and long-term shareholder value."

"The IDILIO TV rollout is not an isolated product launch," Iglesias continued. "It is an example of the broader opportunity to distribute multiple digital services through infrastructure and commercial relationships IQSTEL already has in place."

How the Distribution Pipeline Works

Through integrations with participating mobile operators, IDILIO TV may be offered through direct carrier billing, standalone subscriptions and value-added mobile service bundles.

Direct carrier billing is intended to support the model at scale. Rather than requiring a credit card, app-store account or separate payment relationship, the subscription charge may appear on the customer's existing mobile bill.

For Spanish-speaking markets in Latin America and diaspora communities where card penetration may be uneven, simplifying the payment process could reduce barriers to subscription while using billing infrastructure already operated by participating mobile carriers.

For participating operators, the service could create an incremental revenue opportunity and customer-retention tool without requiring the operator to produce original content. For IQSTEL, each executed agreement could expand the potential audience, increase brand visibility and support subscriber growth—creating a possible compounding or "snowball effect" as operators are added

Experience Scaling Digital Audiences

The initiative will be led by Jorge Becerra, CEO of IQSTEL Digital, who brings more than 25 years of experience developing products and digital services across the media, advertising, television, and digital-services industries, including prior experience building and reaching audiences of approximately 100 million users.

"Reaching a potential audience of 40 million mobile users is an ambitious goal, but it is grounded in experience," said Becerra. "According to Omdia, microdramas are demonstrating strong monetization potential, with more than 60% of global revenue generated through subscriptions and transactional payments. By combining this market opportunity with IQSTEL's global telecommunications platform and full organizational support, we believe we have a powerful foundation for scaling IDILIO TV worldwide."

"We have already launched the IDILIO TV commercial sales pipeline with mobile operators, but this is only the tip of the iceberg," Becerra continued. "Our broader business plan is already underway, and we expect to unveil additional services, partnerships and growth initiatives in the coming months. The 40 million-user objective is an important first milestone, but it is only the beginning of what we believe IQSTEL Digital can build."

A Scalable, High-Margin Recurring-Revenue Model

The model is designed to create a scalable source of recurring revenue for IQSTEL.

For illustrative purposes only, at an assumed penetration rate of 1.25% of a 40 million-user potential audience, the service would reach approximately 500,000 gross paying subscribers by the end of 2027. The gross subscriber count does not include churned subscribers.

Because premium digital content is expected to generate substantially higher margins than traditional wholesale telecommunications services, IQSTEL believes this model could make a meaningful contribution to revenue diversification, margin expansion and long-term profitability.

The 1.25% penetration rate is an assumption used solely to illustrate the arithmetic of the model. This penetration rate does not account for subscriber churn. It is not derived from executed agreements, existing subscriber data or Company forecasts. Actual subscriber adoption, pricing, revenue and profitability will depend on executed operator agreements, commercial terms, market conditions and consumer response. This illustration is not financial guidance or a revenue forecast.

Why Now: A Growing Global Market With a Language Gap

Microdramas—also known as vertical dramas or micronovelas—are serialized fictional programs created specifically for smartphones. Episodes generally run between one and three minutes, are filmed vertically and use fast-paced storytelling and cliffhangers to encourage viewers to continue watching.

The format brings the emotional intensity of the Latin American telenovela tradition to the way consumers now use their phones: frequently, vertically and in short sessions throughout the day.

Although the microdrama category has expanded rapidly, a significant portion of its commercial development has been concentrated in China. IQSTEL believes this creates an opportunity to serve a Spanish-language market that remains comparatively underserved.

Spanish is spoken by more than 630 million people worldwide, including highly connected diaspora communities that maintain strong relationships with their language, culture and entertainment traditions. IQSTEL believes the combination of authentic Spanish-language content and carrier-level distribution can address both the content and distribution components of this opportunity.

IDILIO TV: Institutional Backing and an Operating Platform

IDILIO TV closed a $5 million seed round led by a16z Speedrun, Andreessen Horowitz's media and entertainment accelerator, with participation from Goodwater Capital, Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, and Nubank founder David Vélez individually.

IDILIO TV was co-founded by CEO Gabriela Tafur Standford MBA and CTO Esteban Ramírez, who holds an MBA and a master's degree in computer science from MIT. Its productions are developed by professionals with extensive experience in Colombian and Latin American television.

Its series and executives have received prestigious awards, including the 42nd India Catalina Awards at the 2026 Cartagena International Film Festival (FICCI), where its series Llamado en la Madrugada (Call in the Early Hours) was recognized as Best Vertical Fiction Series.

According to IDILIO TV, the platform has surpassed 2 million downloads, availability in more than 120 countries and 49 original series launched. Its content is available on iOS and Android devices.

Supporting IQSTEL's EBITDA and Margin Expansion Strategy

The IDILIO TV initiative forms part of IQSTEL's broader EBITDA and margin expansion strategy, focused on introducing higher-margin services—including premium digital content, fintech, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and digital health—through the Company's existing global telecommunications ecosystem. IQSTEL believes that expanding its portfolio of scalable, recurring-revenue digital services can improve its revenue mix and, if successfully commercialized, contribute to long-term profitability and EBITDA growth.

IQSTEL reported preliminary, unaudited revenue of approximately $207 million for the first half of 2026, compared with approximately $130 million in the prior-year period. These preliminary figures are subject to completion of the Company's customary review procedures and may change.

The Company views the initial IDILIO TV sales pipeline and the 40 million-user audience objective as the first application of a distribution capability it intends to use repeatedly.

About IDILIO TV

IDILIO TV is a mobile-first entertainment platform producing premium vertical microdramas for Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide. Founded in Colombia and led by CEO and Co-Founder Gabriela Tafur and CTO and Co-Founder Esteban Ramírez, IDILIO TV combines Latin American storytelling with proprietary mobile technology and a mix of subscription, virtual-currency, advertising, and brand-partnership monetization. According to the company, IDILIO TV has surpassed 2 million downloads, and distribution across more than 120 countries, with a catalog of more than 49 original series. For more information, visit www.idilio.tv/en.

About IQSTEL Inc.

IQSTEL Inc. (NASDAQ: IQST) is a global telecommunications and technology company operating through two core business divisions: Telecom and Digital Services. The Telecom Division is the foundation of IQSTEL's global platform, operating across 24 countries with more than 600 telecommunications carrier interconnections and delivering international voice, SMS, messaging, and connectivity solutions to some of the world's largest telecom operators and enterprise customers. Through these customer relationships, IQSTEL's platform has the potential to reach approximately 2.3 billion end users worldwide. Building on this global infrastructure and commercial reach, the Digital Services Division is focused on higher-margin technology solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Communications, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Digital Health, Enterprise Automation, and Content Services. Built through nearly two decades of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, IQSTEL is leveraging the scale and reach of its Telecom business to accelerate the growth of Digital Services and drive its next phase of revenue and Adjusted EBITDA expansion.

For more information, visit:

Telecom: www.iqsteltelecom.com

releases.body:
• Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence Architecture: First commercially available solution for inline, frame-accurate, multimodal AI inference, analysis, and orchestration built natively into the Content Fabric media pipeline for live and derivative content generation
  • New Open Model AI Inference Engine with Fast Text & Vector Storage: Executes AI inline with content distribution and streaming, allowing any frame or video-level model to execute directly in the Fabric distribution pipeline, with inference metadata instantly available globally to the Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline
  • 17 Built-In Models and Extensible API: Covers analysis, segmentation, summarization, and multi-language transcription, with an extensible API for third-party and custom models. Unlike hypervisor cloud solutions, video AI inference requires no media or metadata movement, and AI data can directly drive frame-accurate personalization of live and on-demand content
  • Newest Models and Agentic Processors: Include just-in-time live vertical video generation combining live sports motion analysis, expert focus tracking, and per-player jersey identification; expanded shot, beat, and scene segmentation; "In this video" key moment identification; and personalized synopses and summaries by segment or across entire titles and events
  • Next-Generation Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE): Expanded with EVIE Titles, a unified title-view of AI intelligence; a new AI Runtime for inference management; media-synchronized visualization of AI data by frame, shot, beat, and scene; enhanced ground-truth management; zero-copy AI clipping and composition; automatic dynamic vertical video playout; and a new Eluvio MCP API exposing major functions for agentic orchestration
  • Eluvio at IBC Show 2026: Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026, RAI Amsterdam

BERKELEY, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eluvio today announced that it will showcase major new advances in its Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence architecture and Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) at IBC Show 2026, introducing an expanded open-model AI inference engine, 17 built-in AI models and processors, fast text and vector storage, new live sports intelligence and vertical video capabilities, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) API for agentic orchestration across live events and title libraries.

Eluvio AI is the first commercially available architecture to run frame-accurate, multimodal AI analysis and inference inline within the streaming media generation and distribution pipeline itself. AI models operate directly against live and on-demand video as it flows through the Content Fabric, producing fully time-aligned labels, embeddings, vectors, transcripts, and metadata that are immediately available to the Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline.

Unlike conventional cloud AI workflows that require video to be copied, moved into separate AI processing infrastructure, analyzed, stored again, and frequently re-transcoded to produce derivatives, Eluvio performs the entire workflow in place. There are zero file copies, zero media or metadata movement, and zero re-transcoding across analysis, metadata generation, personalization, derivative creation, and delivery.

The result is a single architecture in which AI intelligence can immediately drive the video itself — enabling frame-accurate search, personalization, clipping, highlights, vertical video, compliance reels, summaries, and other derivative experiences for both live and on-demand content. Eluvio will demonstrate these capabilities live at IBC Show 2026.

"Eluvio AI is fundamentally different from point AI solutions because the intelligence runs inline, with frame accuracy, across live and archival content — without the cost and delay of copying and re-transcoding media before it can be processed and ensembling the power of individual models with frame-accuracy," said Michelle Munson, CEO and co-founder of Eluvio. "The AI is built directly into the video pipeline of the Content Fabric, rather than added afterward as a separate cloud workflow. Everything from identifying action, players, celebrities, speakers, or brands to turning that intelligence into highlights, vertical videos, compliance reels, or personalized content happens in place against the source media and has no limits on size, duration, or ensemble scale. The result is dramatically greater efficiency and speed, while making AI intelligence immediately actionable for personalization and monetization. At IBC, we're excited to show broadcasters and rights holders these capabilities running across both live sports and premium content."

Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence Architecture

At the foundation of the new capabilities is Eluvio's Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence Architecture, which integrates AI inference, multimodal intelligence, text and vector storage, search, generation, and agentic orchestration directly into the Content Fabric media pipeline. Its key capabilities include:

  • Frame-Accurate & Multimodal Intelligence — Video, Audio, Text, Images, Pose & Telemetry: Inference operates at frame and segment level across video, audio, text, images, pose, and multidimensional telemetry. Because the intelligence is generated against the underlying media timeline, no secondary metadata alignment step is required.
  • Zero-Copy, Zero-Movement AI: Models execute directly against Content Fabric media parts. Media does not need to be exported into separate AI pipelines, and resulting intelligence is written directly back into the Fabric where it is immediately available for search, personalization, generation, and distribution.
  • Real-Time Inline Inference for Live and VoD: AI reads live content parts as they are published and writes frame-accurate intelligence back in real time, enabling the same architecture to operate across live sports, live broadcasts, and on-demand libraries.
  • AI-Driven Just-in-Time Media: AI metadata becomes directly actionable by the Content Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline, allowing intelligence generated at a specific frame, shot, beat, scene, player, speaker, or event to dynamically control clipping, composition, personalization, transformation, and delivery.

New Open Model AI Inference Engine, 17 Built-In Models & Fast Text/Vector Storage

Eluvio's expanded AI inference engine provides an open runtime for frame-level, video-level, multimodal, and language models, allowing new open-source, Eluvio-developed, customer-specific, and third-party models to be incorporated without changing the underlying media workflow or moving the media. The platform now includes 17 built-in models and processors spanning multimodal analysis, segmentation, summarization, transcription, identification, search, and generation. Capabilities include:

  • Frame and Video-Level Inference: Models can operate against intra-coded frames, randomly sampled frames, segments, shots, scenes, or entire videos.
  • Shot, Beat & Scene Segmentation: Expanded temporal analysis identifies meaningful structural boundaries within content, providing the foundation for search, summarization, clipping, and composition.
  • Multimodal Embeddings: OpenCLIP, ImageBind, Eluvio-enhanced MediaPipe, and other models support image, video, audio, text, and pose intelligence.
  • Motion, Focus & Identity Analysis: New capabilities include custom motion identification, expert focus tracking, speaker detection and identification, celebrity identification, and player identification.
  • Multi-Language Transcription: Speech-to-text produces time-aligned transcripts that can be combined with speaker recognition and other visual intelligence.
  • Fast Text, Tag & Vector Storage: Model outputs, tags, embeddings, and associated metadata are stored directly within the Fabric and made globally available for immediate search, retrieval, inference, personalization, and generation.
  • Extensible Runtime API: Custom, open-source, and third-party models can be added continuously as the state of the art evolves, without redesigning workflows or creating separate copies of the underlying media.
  • Private Ground Truth & Model Configuration: Customers can create and manage proprietary ground-truth datasets and deploy custom models trained against their own labeled content within the Content Fabric's tenant-isolated security model.

Newest Models & Agentic Processors for Live Sports and Premium Video

At IBC, Eluvio will demonstrate a new generation of models and processors that turn AI analysis directly into actionable media outputs. For live sports, these capabilities include just-in-time vertical video generation combining live motion analysis, expert focus tracking, and per-player jersey identification. The system dynamically determines the focal point for each shot and produces 9:16 vertical presentations from a live 16:9 source — without creating a second encoded video stream or pre-generating separate vertical assets. Additional new processors include:

  • "In This Video" Key Moment Identification: Automatically identifies the most important moments within a title, event, segment, or scene.
  • Personalized Synopsis & Summarization: Generates configurable synopses and summaries for individual segments or complete titles and events, tailored by purpose, length, and style.
  • Live and On-Demand Highlights: Combines AI analysis with play-by-play, player and ball tracking, audio intelligence, and existing metadata to identify and compose personalized highlights.
  • Automatic Chapters & Segmentation: Generates chapter boundaries, labels, and descriptions using shot, beat, scene, topic, mood, and semantic analysis.
  • Zero-Copy Generative Composition: Highlights, trailers, shorts, social clips, compliance reels, and other compositions are represented as references to the original media rather than newly rendered files.
  • Natural-Language Personalization: Agentic processors can use natural-language prompts to control the purpose, content, length, style, and audience of generated outputs.

Next-Generation EVIE and EVIE Titles & Events

The Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) provides the media-facing application layer for this intelligence, allowing users to inspect, search, validate, edit, and act upon AI data while remaining synchronized to the underlying video. The new EVIE Titles & Events experience brings the complete AI stack together around a title — such as a film or television program — or an event, such as a live sports match. New and expanded capabilities include:

  • AI Runtime: A new inference-management environment for selecting, running, and managing AI models and processors against content.
  • Media-Synchronized AI Visualization: Model outputs are organized as synchronized tracks against the media timeline and can be viewed at frame, shot, beat, scene, segment, title, or event level.
  • Deep Multimodal Search: Search across entire content libraries using natural language, images, text, music, metadata, and visual regions to identify matching shots, scenes, clips, or individual frames.
  • Ground-Truth Management: Expanded tools allow media professionals to review and correct AI results and manage private ground truth, including celebrity, speaker, and other identity data.
  • Analyze: Combine transcription, speaker recognition, motion and scene analysis, topics, moods, themes, pose, telemetry, celebrities, brands, and other intelligence within a single synchronized environment.
  • Highlight & Compose: Generate personalized sports highlights, chapter reels, trailers, shorts, compliance reels, and social compositions without duplicating the underlying source media.
  • Dynamic Vertical Video: Automatically identify focal points and crop coordinates shot-by-shot and generate dynamic 9:16 video directly from 16:9 live or on-demand sources through the Fabric's just-in-time pipeline.

New MCP API for Agentic Video Orchestration

Eluvio is also introducing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) API exposing major Content Fabric and Eluvio AI functions for agentic orchestration, allowing ChatGPT, Claude, other LLMs, third-party applications, and agentic systems to execute complex video workflows through natural-language interfaces.

A single agentic workflow can invoke models, analyze content, update vector indices, search video, generate transcriptions, identify key moments, create chapters and highlights, and produce social-ready clips, trailers, shorts, and other compositions. Because the underlying APIs operate directly against Fabric content, these agentic workflows retain the same zero-copy architecture and Content Fabric authorization model. Media remains secured within its tenant and owner-controlled permissions while agents operate against authorized functions and intelligence.

Separately, Eluvio today announced full details of the Global Broadcast Fabric, the newest Content Fabric version spanning broadcast distribution, D2C OTT streaming and monetization, and inline AI video intelligence in a companion press release 

Eluvio at IBC Show 2026

During IBC Show 2026 at the RAI Amsterdam, Eluvio will demonstrate Eluvio AI, EVIE, live sports intelligence, agentic video workflows, and the full capabilities of the Content Fabric in Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and in the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026.

On Thursday, September 10, Eluvio execs will be present at Eluvio's table at the SVGE Europe Summit at De Hallen Studio. On Friday, September 11 from 7:30-10:30 am, Michelle Munson will speak on the "Where does the Signal Go Next" broadcast transition executive breakfast at the Traveler within the RAI. On Saturday, September 12 at 1:00 pm, Eluvio founders Michelle Munson and Serban Simu will deliver a keynote deep dive at the Eluvio stand. On Sunday, September 13 from 2pm-2:15 pm Michelle Munson will present "Beyond Cloud and Satellite: The New Architecture for Broadcast" on the Future Tech Zone stage in Hall 14.

Registration for one-on-one meetings and information about Eluvio's on-site keynote demonstrations at IBC is available at ibc.eluv.io.

About Eluvio

Eluvio is solving the generational problems of video over the Internet with its Content Fabric Protocol — transforming the distribution and monetization of premium video and digital media in contrast to legacy cloud workflows and CDNs. Eluvio serves Amazon Studios/MGM, Cricket Australia, European Professional Club Rugby, SONY, Telstra Broadcast Services, UEFA, United Rugby Championship, Warner Bros., WPALiveTV, WWE, and others.Led by Michelle Munson and Serban Simu, founders and inventors of Aspera, Eluvio is based in Berkeley, California. Eluvio holds 15 issued U.S. patents and has won multiple NAB Streaming Product of the Year awards, the Seicon Grand Prize, the Hollywood Professional Association Engineering Excellence Award, and other industry honors.

@EluvioInc | linkedin.com/company/eluv-io

BERKELEY, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eluvio today announced new advanced features to be showcased at IBC 2026 in its Global Broadcast Fabric, the latest generation of the Content Fabric protocol and global infrastructure, providing comprehensive broadcast transformation from satellite, direct-to-consumer (D2C) OTT streaming and full-stack monetization, and inline AI video intelligence. To schedule a meeting or learn full details about Eluvio's presence at the show visit https://ibc.eluv.io.

"Across the industry, broadcast distribution and D2C streaming are still largely separate tech stacks, and now everyone's bolting AI on as a third," said Michelle Munson, CEO and Co-founder, Eluvio. "The Global Broadcast Fabric supersedes these point hypervisor and CDN solutions and provides a highly efficient and simple solution that unlocks media re-use, deterministic low latency distribution, and AI personalization end-to-end. We've taken advantage of the Content Fabric's zero-copy distribution architecture, frame-accurate metadata, and inline JIT processing to eliminate the cost, complexity, and bottlenecks in advanced media distribution."

Broadcast Transformation: Replacing Satellite and Legacy Cloud Distribution

During the recent World Cup, Eluvio powered a successful commercial pilot with a Tier 1 broadcaster to provide VIP access to live streams and zero-copy VoD rewatch of 105 World Cup matches, surpassing all latency benchmarks, and outperforming the best-case broadcast and streaming latency performance, 15-45+ seconds faster than the legacy streaming services tested worldwide.

At IBC, Eluvio will demonstrate the Global Broadcast Fabric's live broadcast distribution architecture — a decentralized, zero-copy system that replaces satellite distribution, fiber point-to-point connections, and ground-to-cloud multi-point egress for live broadcast feed distribution, extended with new live-operations and monetization capabilities. One decentralized Content Fabric distribution simultaneously serves every downstream taker just-in-time — B2B broadcast affiliates and D2C consumer endpoints — from a single ingest workflow without duplication.

  • Global Broadcast Fabric with Zero-Copy & No Egress Fan-Out Charges: The decentralized any-to-any routing architecture replaces point-to-point links for no traffic duplication at scale. Cost does not increase with receiver count and performance does not degrade as receiver count grows. There are no internal Fabric transit charges and no fees for unused distribution time — delivering satellite-beating economics with over-the-top flexibility.
  • Broadcast Quality: Sub-500ms global latency with sub-millisecond jitter and SMPTE 2022-7 decentralized multipath phase-lock synchronization — broadcast-grade determinism delivered over-the-top, without centralized control or single points of failure. It's the first such capability delivered over IP at global scale.
  • Live Operations/Fast Global Switching & Instant Replay: Via the new Live Stream Manager and APIs, operators can instantly remap broadcast outputs to ingest sources and recover from failures with fast global stream switching and failover. All feeds have zero-copy recording and provide fast DVR and instant replay.
  • In-Fabric Ad Insertion: Native server-side ad insertion (SSAI) with unlimited per-session personalization, enabling ad-supported monetization directly within the distribution pipeline — no third-party ad decisioning infrastructure required.
  • Personalized Virtual Signage in Live Sports at Scale: The fabric metadata carries AI inference applied on source feeds, and executes per-frame rendering engines to apply virtual signage overlays and smart transformations per frame, for just-in-time zero-copy output generation (broadcast TS or consumer streaming). The live feed distribution requirements are constant, independent of the number of variants produced, and all media parts are re-used, making personalized virtual signage possible at scale. 

At IBC, Eluvio and uniqFEED will preview an integrated virtual signage solution for live sports applying frame accurate virtual signage just-in-time per audience group. The original program feed is analyzed once by an AdAPT Analyzer and the extracted metadata is published into Eluvio's Content Fabric as metadata on the Fabric's live stream distribution. Upon a client streaming request, a Content Fabric node executes the AdAPT Renderer inline its just-in-time, frame-level A/V stack to produce a targeted program feed. The ad image is also available to the A/V stack as Content Fabric "parts", as it is also hosted and distributed by the Fabric.  By combining metadata, program feed and received ads via Fabric JIT distribution, a dedicated feed can be created for any viewer at any time. The architecture allows for a high degree of non-intrusive targeting without modification of the player of the viewer and without duplicating the distribution. 

  • Flexible Ingest: JPEG-XS, AVC/HEVC over UDP/RTP/SRT; Ingest from cameras, encoders, and broadcast trucks on-site, or via SRT for wide-area contribution — extending to any sporting venue or remote location.
  • End-to-End Security & Authorization: Multi-layer AES encryption with proxy re-encryption into per-session key spaces; Per-session authorization enforces availability windows, geo-restrictions, ACLs, and entitlements automatically for both B2B SRT/TS and D2C HLS/DASH endpoints. Multi-DRM for D2C, SRT encryption for B2B — all built in.
  • Live Stream Manager: API-driven operational control for inputs, outputs, routing, health and QoS dashboards, multilayer statistics, and batch configuration for tens or hundreds of feeds simultaneously, with a full SDK for partner automation.
  • VIP Command Center / Single Pane of Glass: Desktop and mobile browser application for unlimited global multiview of live feeds at ultra-low latency, with brandable SSO, Fabric policy-enforced stream visibility, and built-in access controls for VIP, NOC, and remote production operations.

Direct-to-Consumer OTT Streaming, Full-Stack Monetization & New White Label Media Wallet & Pocket TV

The Content Fabric is powering thousands of D2C live games and streaming events and hosts hundreds of thousands of live, archive, and library titles for premium brands and creators — with 10x cost savings over legacy CDN and media cloud infrastructure at scale. New features include:

  • Performance and Scale: 8x increase in live stream cross-variant serving; <=30ms segment delivery latency; up to 4x scale of DRM encryption variants; zero-impact global maintenance; and instant-on HFR streaming.
  • Premium Next-Gen Video Formats: Stereoscopic HFR 4K (SBS and MV-HEVC), Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, HDR/HDR10+, full Widevine parameterization, AV1 (upcoming), optimized asset structure for hundreds of language and subtitle tracks.
  • Best in Class White Label OTT Media Wallet UX: Powered by new Media Wallet v3 and Creator Studio CMS — Eluvio provides best-in-class TV, browser, and mobile native white label D2C OTT properties with advanced UX branding, interactive experiences, and configurable live, VOD and clip based content presentation and management.  
  • Superior Viewing & Device Support: Configure and deploy unlimited D2C OTT streaming and archive monetization apps for TV/mobile/browser, B2B portals, and Pocket TV microsites with fast multi-view, integrated DVR, automatic live and VoD content slating, and up-next autoplay. New multi-view sidebar, "In This Video" AI data panel, and expanded entertainment and sports layout options provide a flexible and outstanding UX experience for fans with no code deployment. Fully integrated with the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE), browse and publish zero-copy EVIE clips and compositions.
  • Studio-Grade Monetization: Full SVOD/TVOD (rental and ownership) entitlements, match-based live entitlements, seamless JWT/SSO, and fully integrated Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe in a single checkout flow. CableLabs-compliant Title Metadata API with territory-based offers and delta-only global updates.
  • Pocket TV: A fully white-labeled microsite for live and episodic content sales with zero friction: no login required, single-click Apple Pay and Google Pay, and magic links for return access. No PII collected. Instantly embeddable as a URL in any social post, paid ad, or CRM email. Deployed by a Tier 1 US broadcast network in 2026.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Real-time analytics spanning B2B SRT/TS and D2C HTTP streams; global receiver map with per-receiver performance stats; expanded audience metrics; client-side QoS stats; and sales transaction reporting by currency, product, and country.

Eluvio AI & EVIE: Inline, Frame-Accurate Video Intelligence

Complementing the Content Fabric is a major architecture for universal dynamic video intelligence: Eluvio AI and the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE). Eluvio AI is the first commercially available inline, frame-accurate, multimodal AI built natively into a media platform — running inference on live and VOD content at frame and segment level with zero file copies, zero file movement, and zero transcoding, across open-source, custom, and third-party models. releases.body:
Integrated AEO and GEO strategies help dental practices remain visible as patients increasingly turn to AI tools and voice assistants for answers.

LEHI, Utah, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Gargle, Inc., a dental marketing agency, has expanded its SEO offering to include Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), helping dental practices improve their visibility across traditional search engines, AI-powered platforms, and voice search.

Patients are no longer relying exclusively on traditional Google searches to find a dentist or learn about treatment options. They are also asking detailed questions through AI search tools and voice assistants. Gargle's enhanced SEO strategy is designed to help dental practices appear wherever those conversations begin.

"Search behavior is changing quickly," said Jeff Richins, President of Gargle. "Patients are turning to AI tools and voice search for recommendations and answers. We want to ensure our clients are visible wherever potential patients are searching."

Helping Dental Practices Become the Answer

Traditional SEO helps practices rank for relevant keywords. AEO and GEO build on that foundation by structuring website content so search engines and AI platforms can more easily understand, reference, and present it in response to patient questions.

This allows dental practices to provide helpful information earlier in the patient journey, including answers about symptoms, procedures, costs, recovery, and available treatment options.

"We don't just want a practice to appear in a list of search results," said Richins. "We want it to be recognized as a trusted and relevant answer when a patient is actively looking for care."

Optimizing for High-Intent Patient Searches

Gargle's approach focuses on the questions patients ask when they are considering treatment or choosing a dental provider. By creating clear, useful, and locally relevant content, practices can improve their visibility during the moments most likely to influence a patient's decision.

The strategy is designed to support visibility across:

  • Traditional Google search results
  • Google AI-powered search experiences
  • Featured snippets and answer boxes
  • Voice assistants
  • Generative AI search platforms
  • Local and map-based searches

Built Into Gargle's Existing SEO Offering

AEO and GEO are integrated directly into Gargle's SEO product. Existing clients do not need to purchase separate software, manage another vendor, or add another layer to their marketing strategy.

"There are no extra tools or added complexity," said Richins. "We've incorporated these strategies into the SEO work we already provide, giving our clients greater value while preparing them for the future of search."

By expanding beyond traditional rankings, Gargle is helping dental practices build a stronger digital presence and remain competitive as online discovery continues to evolve.

About Gargle, Inc.

Gargle is a full-service dental marketing agency offering customized solutions including websites, SEO, paid search, social media, digital advertising, reputation management, and marketing performance reporting. Gargle helps dental practices improve their visibility, understand their marketing results, and connect with more prospective patients through personalized strategies and human-first support.

TORONTO, Sept. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- SiriusXM Canada today announced its extensive coverage plans for the 2026 NFL season, which will feature live broadcasts of every game, and the addition of multiple new voices on the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel.

Every NFL game airs live on SiriusXM

The 2026 NFL Kickoff Presented by YouTube TV takes place September 9 (8:20 pm ET), when the defending champion Seattle Seahawks face the New England Patriots in a rematch of last February's Super Bowl. The following day, September 10 (8:35 pm ET), features the league's first international game of the season, as 2025 NFL MVP Matthew Stafford and the Los Angeles Rams play the San Francisco 49ers in Melbourne, Australia.

Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM Canada listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the SiriusXM app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup. Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios. The schedule of games airing on SiriusXM for Week 1 is available here: siriusxm.ca/sports

Listeners can access NFL game broadcasts and the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel with SiriusXM's most popular subscription plans, including Platinum, All Access and Music & Entertainment.

New voices join SiriusXM's NFL programming

In addition to the live game broadcasts, fans get in-depth NFL talk 365 days a year on SiriusXM NFL Radio (channel 88), the only 24/7 radio channel dedicated to the NFL. Multiple current and former NFL players are joining the roster and will be featured hosts on the channel this season.

Super Bowl XLIV MVP and 13-time Pro Bowl quarterback Drew Brees, who was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame this summer, is joining the cast of "Let's Go!" – the weekly show hosted by L.A. Rams quarterback and 2025 NFL MVP Matthew Stafford, three-time National Sportswriter of the Year Peter King, and Emmy Award-winning broadcaster Jim Gray. The new season of "Let's Go!" debuts on Monday, September 7 (6 pm ET), and will feature Stafford previewing the Rams matchup against the 49ers three days later at the famous Melbourne Cricket Ground in the first ever NFL game played in Australia.

New episodes of "Let's Go" will debut every Monday on SiriusXM NFL Radio. After airing on SiriusXM, the show is available on all major podcast platforms, with additional bonus content available only on the SiriusXM app. "Let's Go!" is produced by Scratchy Productions and SiriusXM.

"I'm excited to join Jim Gray and our great list of guests on 'Let's Go' as we break down the biggest moments in the NFL every week, giving fans tons of insight and entertainment," said Brees.

Also joining SiriusXM this season are multiple active or free agent NFL players. New York Giants defensive tackle Shelby Harris, New York Jets linebacker Demario Davis, and free agent wide receiver Brandin Cooks will serve as rotating hosts alongside Carolina Panthers long snapper J.J. Jansen on the weekly show, "The Players' Point," the only radio show hosted entirely by active NFL players. Los Angeles Chargers fullback Alec Ingold also returns as a co-host. "The Players' Point" airs Tuesdays at 6 pm ET on SiriusXM NFL Radio.

Adam Thielen, who retired earlier this year after a 13-year NFL career, has signed on as a SiriusXM host and will be heard Tuesdays from 10am-noon ET on "Airing It Out" on SiriusXM NFL Radio alongside Bob Papa. Thielen entered the league in 2014 as an undrafted free agent and spent 10 seasons with the Minnesota Vikings, where he emerged as a star, was voted to two Pro Bowls and selected as a second-team All-Pro in 2017.

SiriusXM NFL Radio hosts include Hall of Famers, former execs and NFL legends

SiriusXM NFL Radio's team of hosts also includes Hall of Famers Tim Brown and Bill Polian, former NFL executives Pat Kirwan, Tom Telesco and Ran Carthon, and NFL Legends including Rich Gannon, Jacob Hester, Todd Haley, Brad Hopkins, Ryan Leaf, Kirk Morrison, Allen Robinson, Isaiah Stanback, Max Starks, Robert Turbin, Solomon Wilcots, Matt Simms, Leger Douzable, Brian Hoyer, Christian Fauria, Ben DiNucci and Ryan Harris. 

SiriusXM NFL Radio voices also include a number of NFL insiders and radio veterans including Vic Carucci, Zig Fracassi, Dan Leberfeld, Jade McCarthy, David Moulton, Bruce Murray, Bob Papa, Amber Theoharis, Amy Lawrence, Andrew Siciliano, Mike Dempsey, Bob Harris and Damon Amendolara.

Sundays during the season, SiriusXM's "NFL Sunday Drive" show airs live from noon to 8 pm ET as all afternoon games are in progress. Hosts Steve Torre and Bill Lekas share up-to-the-moment scores and highlights, take listeners in and out of multiple live game broadcasts so they can hear the most exciting game action in one place, and conduct one-on-one postgame interviews with the day's star players.

For more on SiriusXM's NFL programming, including a link to the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel and NFL game schedules go to siriusxm.ca/NFL.

Sirius XM Canada Inc., operating as SiriusXM Canada, is the country's leading audio entertainment company. releases.title: SONY PICTURES' SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY BECOMES CJ 4DPLEX'S HIGHEST-GROSSING FILM OF ALL TIME ACROSS SCREENX AND 4DX
releases.body:
Film sets new all-time CJ 4DPLEX record in just 33 days, drawing more than 6.7 million moviegoers across 1,200 screens with a record 40% average occupancy

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading entertainment technology and content company specializing in premium film formats, cinematic production, visual effects and immersive experiences, today announced that Sony Pictures' Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the highest-grossing film of all time across its SCREENX and 4DX formats, generating more than $104 million in combined global box office.

In just 33 days, Spider-Man: Brand New Day surpassed the previous all-time CJ 4DPLEX global box office record established by Avatar: The Way of Water, which accumulated $103 million across its 228-day theatrical run. The unprecedented speed at which Spider-Man: Brand New Day reached the milestone underscores the growing global demand for differentiated premium theatrical experiences and the increasing value SCREENX and 4DX can deliver to filmmakers, studios and exhibitors.

Since its global release, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has drawn more than 6.7 million admissions across SCREENX and 4DX, playing more than 115,000 shows across 1,200 screens worldwide. The film has achieved a record 40% average occupancy rate, demonstrating extraordinary audience demand and the ability of premium formats to drive moviegoers to theaters and maximize the value of every auditorium. It also set opening records for SCREENX in 36 countries and 4DX in 22 countries.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day marked the debut of CJ 4DPLEX's "Shot for SCREENX" initiative and the first time the company collaborated with filmmakers from on-set production through theatrical exhibition. Working alongside director Destin Daniel Cretton and the filmmaking team, SCREENX provided a new creative canvas designed to extend select moments beyond the traditional screen and surround audiences with imagery conceived specifically for the format, moving SCREENX further upstream in the creative process and giving filmmakers new tools to expand the scale and impact of their storytelling.

"The global response to Spider-Man: Brand New Day has been extraordinary," said Steven O'Dell, President, International Marketing & Distribution, Sony Pictures Entertainment. "The success of Shot for SCREENX demonstrates how creative collaboration can enhance the theatrical experience, and we're thrilled to see that innovation resonate with audiences around the world."

"Spider-Man: Brand New Day has achieved something no film has ever done across SCREENX and 4DX, and to establish this record in just 33 days makes the accomplishment even more extraordinary," said Jun Bang, CEO, CJ 4DPLEX. "As the first film in our Shot for SCREENX initiative, it represents an important evolution in how we collaborate with filmmakers and studios. We are incredibly grateful to Sony Pictures, Destin Daniel Cretton and the entire filmmaking team for embracing this new creative approach and helping demonstrate what is possible when premium formats become part of the filmmaking process from the beginning."

"This record demonstrates the tremendous opportunity premium formats create across the theatrical ecosystem," said Don Savant, CEO, CJ 4DPLEX Americas. "For studios and filmmakers, SCREENX and 4DX provide differentiated ways to showcase their biggest films, create excitement and drive incremental box office. For exhibitors, they provide a premium experience audiences actively seek out and are willing to pay more to enjoy. Most importantly, we are incredibly grateful to Sony Pictures for embracing our vision for 'Shot for SCREENX' and working with us to make it a reality. Their partnership and commitment were instrumental in achieving this historic success."

With SCREENX and 4DX now reaching audiences across major theatrical markets worldwide, studios and filmmakers have a powerful global premium platform through which to differentiate major releases, while exhibitors can offer audiences experiences that cannot be replicated at home.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is now playing in SCREENX and 4DX theaters worldwide.

About Spider-Man: Brand New Day

It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn't forgotten them.

Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton. Written by Chris McKenna & Erik Sommers. Based on the MARVEL Comic Book by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko. Produced by Kevin Feige, p.g.a., Amy Pascal, p.g.a., Avi Arad, and Rachel O'Connor, p.g.a. Executive Producers are Louis D'Esposito and David Cain. The film stars Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, Michael Mando and Mark Ruffalo.

About CJ 4DPLEX

CJ 4DPLEX is a proud subsidiary of CJ Group, Korea's leading lifestyle and culture company. Headquartered in Sangam, Seoul, CJ 4DPLEX develops and operates the world's leading premium cinema technologies, partnering with major exhibitors across the Americas, Europe, Asia and the Middle East to deliver SCREENX, 4DX and ULTRA 4DX experiences. Through continuous innovation, the company is committed to expanding immersive storytelling and creating new ways for audiences around the world to experience cinema.

About SCREENX

SCREENX is the world's first multi-projection cinema technology, delivering a 270-degree panoramic viewing experience that extends select scenes beyond the main screen and onto the auditorium walls. By surrounding audiences with exclusive imagery created or specially formatted for SCREENX, the technology enhances immersion while preserving the filmmaker's creative vision.

About 4DX

4DX is the world's leading immersive theatrical technology, enhancing films with synchronized motion seats and more than 21 environmental effects, including wind, water, scent, fog, lightning, vibration and more. By engaging multiple senses, 4DX transforms moviegoing into a fully immersive entertainment experience that places audiences inside the action.

CJ 4DPLEX can be found at www.cj4dplex.com.

releases.title: Dance Legends Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke Join Moises to Build Responsible AI Tools for Musicians
releases.body:
Electronic pioneers will help shape new DJ and producer workflows for the creative suite used by 80 million musicians

SALT LAKE CITY, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Moises, the creative suite for musicians, today announced that Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke have joined the company as the first members of its Artist Partnerships program. Both artists will help shape new producer- and DJ-focused features and contribute to conversations about the future of music technology and responsible AI. The new program follows the appointment of Charlie Puth as Moises' Chief Music Officer and expands the company's effort to put working artists at the center of how its creative tools are built.

At a time when generative AI is raising questions around consent, ownership, and replacement, Moises is taking a different approach: rather than generating finished songs from prompts, its creative suite helps musicians practice, perform, and create while keeping artistic decision-making in their hands. The company trains its AI models only on licensed and authorized content.

"Electronic music has always moved forward because artists were willing to experiment with new technology," said Geraldo Ramos, founder and CEO of Moises. "The next generation of creative tools has to be built with musicians, not around them. Armin and Luke understand the craft, the community, and the responsibility that comes with building tools musicians will actually use."

Architects of Modern Dance Music

For more than two decades, van Buuren has shaped the sound, culture, and worldwide reach of electronic music. One of only three artists to be named the world's No. 1 DJ by DJ Mag five times, he is a GRAMMY-nominated artist, co-founder of Armada Music, and host of A State of Trance, the radio show that reaches more than 40 million listeners.

"Technology has always been part of how electronic music evolves," said van Buuren. "What matters is whether the artist stays in control. Moises approaches AI with respect for the musician's own sound and decision-making, and I'm excited to help build tools that make producers faster and more expressive without taking the creativity out of their hands."

Laidback Luke is a DJ, producer, label founder, and educator whose influence helped shape the rise of modern EDM. Through Mixmash Records, his production forums, and masterclasses, he has championed emerging artists including Avicii and Afrojack. His collaboration and remix credits include Daft Punk, Kanye West, Rihanna, Madonna, Jay-Z, Pharrell, and others.

"Every generation of producers gets new tools, but the best tools do not do the work for you," said Laidback Luke. "They help you hear more, learn faster, and make stronger creative decisions. That is the kind of AI I want young producers to grow up with."

What Comes Next

Moises chose dance music as the starting point for the program because electronic artists have long been among the first to transform new technology into new forms of musical expression. Over the coming months, the company plans to announce additional high-profile artists and producers across multiple genres.

The program builds on the company's recent industry partnerships, including Fender, which selected Moises as the first AI technology partner for its Studio Pro DAW, and Ableton, which chose Moises' stem-separation technology for Ableton Live. Moises has also partnered with Blackstar Amps, the Whitney Houston Estate, and Cory Henry.

Learn more: https://moises.ai 

About Moises

Moises is the creative suite used by 80 million musicians worldwide. The platform gives everyone from hobbyists to world-class artists studio-level tools to practice, perform, create, and collaborate across mobile, desktop, and web. Powered by more than 50 proprietary AI models, Moises processes nearly six years' worth of audio every day and delivers capabilities including stem separation, songwriting and production tools, audio enhancement, and performance recording. Built by a global team with experience at Spotify, Pandora and TikTok, Moises was named Apple's 2024 iPad App of the Year and is available worldwide in 33 languages.

LITITZ, Pa., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leading cross-channel personalization platform Listrak announced its new Email Marketing Audit tool, which allows marketers to audit any marketing email against industry best practices for deliverability, accessibility, mobile optimization, content, and conversion.  The tool is free, with no signup required, and is the retail industry's first of its kind. Listrak's Email Marketing Audit evaluates any marketing email against 30+ proven email marketing best practices across the key elements of a high-performing email.  The audit reviews emails for:

  • Content: Strong email content helps capture attention and encourage subscribers to take action.
    • The audit reviews elements such as Preheader, SMS Opt-In Invitation, Social Media, Manage Preferences Link, Early Call-to-Action, Subject Line Spam Triggers, Clickable Logo, and more.

  • Composition: How an email is built affects how it renders, loads, and performs across inboxes and devices.
    • The audit analyzes Mobile-First Design, Gmail Clipping Risk, Image Payload Size, Coupon Code Accessibility, GIF Usage, Button-Style CTAs, Live Text, among other key elements.

releases.title: SOCAN is Standing Up for Music Creators and Publishers with Legal Action Against Suno Inc. for Unauthorized Use of Music in Generative AI Platform
releases.body:
Multibillion- dollar platform is publicly streaming AI‑generated outputs that replicate songs in SOCAN's repertoire without consent or compensation

TORONTO, Sept. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- SOCAN has filed a lawsuit against Suno Inc., alleging that the company's generative AI platform is producing and streaming outputs that replicate human-created musical works without consent or payment, and as a result has infringed the performing rights in musical works in SOCAN's repertoire.

"SOCAN has a responsibility to act when the rights of music creators and publishers are put at risk. The evidence shows that the Suno platform has generated and streamed outputs that copy works in our repertoire, and that cannot go unchallenged," said Jennifer Brown, SOCAN CEO. "Innovation can't come at the expense of human creativity. The future of music must belong to the people who make it."

Suno has built its business by training its generative AI models on virtually all music files readily accessible on the Internet, without obtaining the necessary permissions or licences. SOCAN has identified Suno outputs that are identical or similar to songs in SOCAN's repertoire and have been generated and streamed without consent or compensation.

SOCAN's legal action is a necessary and proactive step to ensure that human music creation is valued, respected, and compensated.

Allegations of infringement

SOCAN's claim alleges that, by making the Suno platform available to the public in Canada, using it to generate and make available outputs that replicate songs in SOCAN's repertoire, and streaming those outputs to users in Canada and around the world, Suno has infringed SOCAN's performing rights in the underlying songs. The lawsuit lists a sample of 150 publicly available Suno outputs that SOCAN has identified. SOCAN expects other unauthorized outputs and activities to come to light as the litigation progresses.

"Suno's failure to meet its copyright obligations led us to pursue litigation," said Andrea Kokonis, Chief Legal Officer and General Counsel. "Our evidence is clear, and so is our objective: to establish that AI companies must respect the rights of music creators and publishers. This case is fundamentally about ensuring that long‑standing copyright principles continue to apply in the AI era."

SOCAN's action asserts that AI development must operate within the law and respect the rights of those who make music possible.

SOCAN will not comment on the claim beyond what is in the court record.

For more information visit the SOCAN litigation webpage.

About SOCAN

SOCAN is Canada's largest member-owned music rights organization, championing the fundamental value of music and the people who create it. SOCAN collects license fees for the public performance and reproduction of music, matches them to rights holders, and distributes them as royalties to songwriters, composers and music creators and publishers in Canada and around the world. With more than a century of expertise and innovation, SOCAN stands for respect and fair compensation for creative work – protecting, recognizing, and celebrating its over 200,000 songwriter, composer, and music publisher members. For more information: www.socan.com.

releases.title: ForwardX Robotics Launches Brownfield Automation Whitepaper: Four Capabilities for Scaling AMRs in Existing Factories
releases.body:
BEIJING, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As manufacturers increasingly automate existing facilities, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) can improve internal material flow without major infrastructure changes. However, brownfield environments present challenges beyond robot navigation. Existing layouts, traffic patterns, material flows, IT infrastructure, and ongoing production must all be considered.

For manufacturers, the objective is not simply to deploy more robots, but to integrate automation into existing operations while maintaining safety, flexibility, reliable material flow, and long-term scalability as production requirements continuously evolve.

ForwardX Robotics' new Brownfield Automation Whitepaper identifies four capabilities critical to successful brownfield automation.

1. Brownfield Systems Engineering

Successful automation starts with understanding the factory as a complete production system. Material flows are connected to production requirements, equipment utilization, inventory movement, traffic, and IT systems. ForwardX combines material flow analysis, production constraints, traffic engineering, IT/OT integration, and deployment planning before automation is introduced. This methodology has been developed through five large-scale automotive OEM deployments involving more than 100 AMRs.

2. Engineering Adaptability

Every brownfield facility has different floor conditions, aisle widths, traffic patterns, material carriers, network infrastructure, and production layouts. Automation therefore needs to adapt to the facility rather than requiring costly standardization. ForwardX uses vision-based autonomy, enabling AMRs to navigate without floor markers or magnetic guidance. At Chery Dalian, more than 480 AMRs operate alongside hundreds of manually driven forklifts through perception, dynamic obstacle avoidance, and coordinated traffic management.

3. Production-Safe Deployment

In an operating factory, deployment methodology can be as important as the automation technology itself. ForwardX uses phased implementation, digital validation, integration testing, controlled production cutover, and progressive commissioning. Software interfaces and communication with MES, WMS, ERP, and other factory systems are verified before robots enter live production, reducing implementation risk and supporting production continuity.

4. Large-Scale Fleet Orchestration

Scaling from an AMR pilot to hundreds of robots requires coordinated fleet intelligence. At Chery Dalian, 484 AMRs operate at one manufacturing site under ForwardX's unified fleet management platform. The f(x) Fleet Manager supports dynamic task allocation, traffic management, charger optimization, and real-time fleet visibility across different robot architectures.

The whitepaper demonstrates that brownfield automation requires more than autonomous robots. Manufacturers must evaluate whether an automation solution can understand existing operations, adapt to facility constraints, deploy safely, and coordinate fleets at scale. These capabilities provide a practical framework for manufacturers evaluating AMR automation within existing production environments.

releases.title: Local Media Consortium Launches AI Accelerator
releases.body:
New program will help local media companies assess AI readiness, identify opportunities for implementation, and shape future training, resources and services

NEW YORK, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Local Media Consortium (LMC) today announced the launch of the AI Accelerator, a new program designed to help local media companies better understand, evaluate and implement artificial intelligence strategies that improve operations, strengthen business performance and support long-term sustainability. As part of the program, the LMC is partnering with Stellis AI to conduct an AI Readiness & Digital Tech Stack Assessment for participating members.

The assessment comes as artificial intelligence continues to move up the priority list for local media organizations. In the LMC's recent industry survey, 46% of respondents identified AI for operations as one of the top trends on their radar for 2026, underscoring growing interest in practical applications that can improve efficiency, streamline workflows and support business growth.

The AI Readiness & Digital Tech Stack Assessment will provide participating organizations with a comprehensive evaluation of their current technology environment, AI readiness, operational priorities and opportunities for implementation. Findings, which will be gleaned from a survey that kicked off on August 25, will help organizations identify practical ways to improve workflows, increase efficiency, reduce costs, strengthen audience engagement and uncover new revenue opportunities.

"Artificial intelligence has quickly moved from a future consideration to an active business priority for many local media organizations," said Fran Wills, CEO of the Local Media Consortium. "Our members are looking for practical guidance on where AI can create the greatest impact for their organizations. The AI Accelerator will help participants assess their readiness, identify opportunities and build a roadmap for implementation so they can make informed decisions with confidence."

Participating organizations will receive individualized findings and recommendations to support future planning and implementation efforts. Assessment results will remain proprietary to participating organizations and the LMC, while aggregated insights will help guide future AI-related education, programming, partnerships and support resources for members.

The AI Accelerator is part of a broader effort by LMC and Digital On-Demand Services (DODS), which helps local media organizations get important work done by connecting them with the right experts and managing the work from idea to execution. The AI Readiness & Digital Tech Stack Assessment is supported through funding from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation as part of the News Media Help Desk, an online resource created by the LMC and The Reynolds Journalism Institute that guides newsrooms toward strategic decisions that ensure the long-term future of local media.

"By helping organizations move from AI experimentation to implementation, this initiative will provide the LMC with valuable insights into the needs and priorities of its membership," said Liz Hayes, program manager for DODS. "Those insights will inform future training programs, educational resources, strategic partnerships and services designed to support local media organizations as they navigate a rapidly evolving technology landscape."

About the Local Media Consortium

The Local Media Consortium delivers more than $60 million in annual economic value through digital partnerships and strategic initiatives on behalf of more than 150 local media companies in top markets across the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, and includes more than 5,000 newspaper, radio, TV and online-only news outlets. By harnessing the combined volume and scale of its members, the LMC reduces costs and increases revenue with technology and service providers. releases.title: New Malwarebytes Research Shows Scammers are Tailoring Attacks to Specific Platforms, From Text Toll Scams to Social Media Romance Cons
releases.body:
MrBeast is the most impersonated person, Google is the most impersonated brand, and noon ET on Fridays is the prime time for scam texts

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Malwarebytes, a global leader in real-time cyber protection, released new research showing how criminals are tailoring specific scam types to the platforms where they are most likely to succeed. Nine in ten toll scams, the fake unpaid-toll messages that threaten fines or license suspension, arrive by email or text, while roughly six in ten romance scams play out on social media.

The findings draw on global data from Malwarebytes threat research systems. Malwarebytes analyzed more than 20 distinct scam types, from tech support and refund scams to sextortion and scareware, and found that each one favors a specific delivery channel.

Read the full report

"Scammers are getting more deliberate about where and when they reach people," said Shahak Shalev, Global Head of Scam and AI Research, Malwarebytes. "Certain scams work better on certain platforms, at certain moments, and scammers repeat what works. Knowing where and when particular scams are most likely to appear can help people recognize them before they engage."

Key findings

  • Every scam type has a preferred platform. Fake giveaway scams are far more likely to arrive through a social media feed than by email or text. Half of all IRS scams come by phone call. Job scams favor email, while romance scams mostly arrive through social media, and tech support scams mostly favor phone calls.
  • The web is still the biggest hunting ground. Despite the rise of social media and messaging apps, scams are reaching us through the web more than any other platform, followed by email and SMS.
  • MrBeast is the most impersonated person, ahead of Elon Musk and Donald Trump. MrBeast appears in roughly 30% of impersonation scams tracked by Malwarebytes, ranging from crypto giveaways to transfer-fee swindles. Elon Musk ranks second and Donald Trump ranks third.
  • Noon ET is the "golden hour" for scam texts. Malwarebytes data shows scam text volume peaks at 12 p.m. ET, roughly 874% busier than the quietest hour, 1 a.m. ET.
  • Scam texts build all week and peak on Fridays. Volume rises steadily from a low point on Sunday, and by Friday, people receive roughly 50% more fraudulent text messages than they did at the start of the week.
  • Scammers favor the world's best-known brands. Based on reports from Malwarebytes users, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Roblox, and Amazon are the five most impersonated brands, in that order. Google's name appears in scam content at least twice as often as Amazon's name.
  • Gaming platforms are an increasingly popular target. Roblox, Steam, Discord, and Minecraft were the most impersonated gaming platforms. Roblox saw a 15% spike in scam activity from mid-June to mid-July, and Steam saw a 19% spike over the same period.
  • One in five flagged sessions is high-risk. Malwarebytes Scam Guard, which checks messages, phone numbers, texts, social media messages and links against its threat intelligence database, flags approximately one in five analyzed sessions as high-risk, meaning they could lead to a loss of at least $1,000 or other personal harm.

How to spot and stop scams

Malwarebytes recommends the following steps to reduce risk:

  • Do not click links or call phone numbers in unsolicited emails, texts, or social media DMs.
  • When in doubt, verify a message's legitimacy by going directly to the company's official website and contacting it through official channels. Do not follow sponsored search results to get there, since these can be scams.
  • Never share personal details, PINs, passwords, payment information, or verification codes during an unsolicited call. Legitimate companies will not ask for passwords or verification codes over the phone. Hang up and call back using the organization's official phone number.
  • Use a browser extension that blocks scam and phishing sites, such as Malwarebytes Browser Guard, which can flag a fake storefront before a user lands on it.
  • Install a mobile security product that filters out scam and spam text messages like Malwarebytes Mobile Security alongside comprehensive security with real-time protection for your desktop.
  • Check whether a message is legitimate with Malwarebytes Scam Guard, which analyzes any content, message, phone number, text or link against its threat intelligence database and provides information on red flags and recommended next steps.

Methodology

The data in this report comes from Malwarebytes proprietary threat research systems, collected between April 15 and July 14, 2026. All data is anonymized and reflects what Malwarebytes is able to observe through its own infrastructure.

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Unsigned Only Music Awards is proud to announce the winners of the 2026 competition, recognizing an extraordinary group of independent artists from around the world whose music stood out among thousands of entries.

This year's top honor, Artist of the Year, has been awarded to Artur Menezes for "Once Again." In addition, Unsigned Only has named winners across its diverse range of categories, celebrating outstanding talent in all genres of contemporary music.

Unlike traditional awards programs, Unsigned Only is specifically dedicated to independent and unsigned artists. Winners are selected by a panel of accomplished recording artists, music managers, booking agents, journalists, and other music-industry professionals with extensive experience in their respective fields. For a complete list of judges go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/judges.

Each winner receives a custom award designed by Society Awards, the company behind high-profile entertainment awards including the Emmy and Golden Globe awards. The Artist of the Year also receives a $20,000 cash prize.

Many past winners of Unsigned Only have gone on to sign major label deals, tour internationally, secure licensing placements, and build successful careers, including: GAYLE, Ingrid Andress, Jordan Adetunji, Gabby Barrett, Coco Jones, Tenille Arts, Faouzia, Jordan St. Cyr, Brett Young, and many more.

Artur Menezes, the Artist of The Year recipient, is a Brazilian-born, Los Angeles-based guitarist, singer, and songwriter. Known for his explosive guitar playing, soulful vocals, and distinctive ability to blend Blues and Rock, Menezes has built an international reputation. His career has taken him from the blues clubs of Chicago to major festivals and stages across the United States, Europe, and South America. He performed at Lollapalooza Brazil 2026 as the only blues rock artist in the lineup. He has shared stages with artists including Buddy Guy, Joe Satriani, Steve Vai, and Christone "Kingfish" Ingram, among others.

Upon learning of his Unsigned Only win, Menezes said, "It's hard to put into words what I'm feeling right now, but one thing I can say is this: besides the art itself, recognition is one of the best things an artist can have. Thank you so much!"

Menezes' accomplishments already include the Blues Foundation's Gibson/Albert King Award for Best Guitarist and appearances on the Experience Hendrix Tour and Eric Clapton's Crossroads Guitar Festival. Guitar Player Magazine selected him one of the 'Top Best 25 New Blues Artists', while Joe Bonamassa singled him out as one of the most exciting modern blues guitarists "who shreds the blues and is not afraid to do that."

"Artur Menezes is the kind of artist Unsigned Only was created to recognize," said Candace Avery and Jim Morgan, founders of Unsigned Only. "His extraordinary musicianship, distinctive voice, and authenticity come through in every note – and his ability to make the guitar speak with such power and emotion is truly remarkable. You can hear the years of dedication in his playing, but you can also hear the joy, passion, and personality behind it."

In addition to Menezes, there is a winner in each of the 24 categories. Hailing from all over the world they range from talented amateurs to seasoned performers. For a complete list of winners, go to: https://www.unsignedonly.com/winners.

releases.title: Blubrry Brings Unified Video and Audio Podcast Publishing to Apple Podcasts
releases.body:
Blubrry Publisher customers can upload one video episode and make it available to watch or listen through a single podcast feed

COOPERSVILLE, Mich., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blubrry Podcasting today announced that it now works with Apple Podcasts to integrate HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) video into shows published through Blubrry Publisher.

The new workflow allows Blubrry hosting customers to upload one MP4 video episode and make it available in video and audio formats through a single RSS feed. Blubrry automatically creates an HLS video version for Apple Podcasts, retains the original video file and generates an MP3 audio version for podcast apps that do not support HLS video.

For creators, this means one upload, one episode and one feed to manage. For audiences using Apple Podcasts, it provides the flexibility to watch or listen and switch between audio and video with a tap.

"Video podcasting should give creators more ways to share their work without requiring a separate publishing process," said Barry Kantz, CEO at Blubrry Podcasting. "Blubrry Publisher customers can upload one video episode, continue managing one podcast feed and give their audience the choice to watch or listen."

A More Flexible Experience on Apple Podcasts

Video on Apple Podcasts uses HTTP Live Streaming video. HLS video divides an episode into smaller segments and prepares it at multiple quality levels.

As someone watches, Apple Podcasts can adjust the video quality based on the strength of their Wi-Fi or cellular connection. This adaptive delivery can help video begin playing faster and continue with fewer buffering interruptions as connection conditions change.

Because video and audio are connected to the same episode, audiences can switch between audio and video with a tap without searching for another version of the show.

One Upload, Three Available Formats

When a Blubrry Publisher customer uploads an MP4 video episode, Blubrry automatically prepares:

  • An HLS video version for Apple Podcasts
  • The original uploaded video file
  • An MP3 audio version for audio-focused podcast apps

All three formats are included within the same RSS feed.

Apple Podcasts uses the HLS video version. Other podcast apps can use the HLS video, original video file or MP3 audio enclosure based on the formats they support.

This removes the need to upload separate audio and video episodes or maintain parallel feeds for the same show.

Available Through Blubrry Publisher

After connecting Apple Podcasts Connect to Blubrry, customers can publish video episodes through their existing Blubrry Publisher workflow.

Blubrry automatically prepares the uploaded video as a 1080p Full HD HLS video version and creates an MP3 audio version. Some processing time is required before the episode becomes available to watch on Apple Podcasts.

The feature is currently available to Blubrry hosting customers using Blubrry Publisher. It is not available for shows published through the PowerPress podcasting plugin at this time.

PowerPress customers can continue using their current WordPress publishing workflow without making any changes.

To get started, customers must generate an API key through Apple Podcasts Connect and upload the key file within their Blubrry dashboard.

Customers can learn more at HLS at Blubrry or follow the setup instructions in Blubrry's documentation.

About Blubrry Podcasting

Blubrry Podcasting provides podcast hosting, publishing, audience statistics, monetization and distribution tools for audio and video creators. Its services include Blubrry Publisher, the PowerPress podcasting plugin for WordPress, IAB-certified podcast statistics, podcast websites and tools for independent creators, businesses and podcast networks.
