releases.title: Fractal and Sky Systemz Launch Contractor Portal to Connect Construction Suppliers and Contractors
releases.body:
The new product extends the platform across the construction ecosystem, connecting suppliers and contractors through one secure, branded experience to review invoices, sign agreements and complete payments powered by Fractal.

LEXINGTON, Ky., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sky Systemz, a software company and Fractal, a leading FinTech company serving the construction industry, announced today the launch of the SkyOS Contractor Portal, a new customer-facing experience that connects construction materials suppliers directly with the businesses they serve.

Sky Systemz and Fractal launch Contractor Portal, connecting suppliers, contractors and payments.

The launch represents an important expansion of the SkyOS product ecosystem. While SkyOS has helped suppliers streamline payments, invoicing, customer management and business operations, the Contractor Portal extends that connected experience downstream, giving their account customers a dedicated place to manage and complete the payment process, review and sign contractual agreements. 

For Sky Systemz, that means supporting not only its customers, but its customers' customers. Bridging one place to review, sign and pay. A complete demo can be scheduled on their website at Skysystemz.com

Through the SkyOS Contractor Portal, account customers can sign in using their email and access invoices and payment requests from one centralized, merchant-branded experience. Customers can see what is outstanding, overdue or complete; review transaction and line-item details; complete required agreements; and securely pay by card or bank through the Fractal payment experience.

After payment, customers can access their paid invoice, receipt and completed agreement when applicable.

"The Contractor Portal changes where SkyOS sits within the construction software ecosystem," said Brian Nichols, Founder and CEO of Sky Systemz. "We've built technology that helps suppliers simplify how they operate, get paid and manage their businesses. Now we're extending that experience to the companies they serve. By connecting both sides of the transaction, we can remove friction for the customer while giving the supplier greater visibility, control and efficiency."

Connecting Both Sides of the Construction Transaction

The Contractor Portal is designed specifically for the account-based relationships common across ready mix, asphalt, aggregates and the broader construction industry.

Rather than introducing another disconnected payment system, the portal works directly with SkyOS. SkyOS remains the system of record for payment status, while payments are securely facilitated through Fractal.

Completed Contractor Portal payments automatically flow back into SkyOS. If a supplier records an offline payment, such as cash or check, the Contractor Portal reflects that the transaction has been paid. Canceled or deleted invoices and payment requests are also updated automatically.

The result is a connected experience on both sides of the transaction: greater self-service and visibility for the customer, with less manual reconciliation and administrative back-and-forth for the supplier.

Key Contractor Portal capabilities include:

  • Centralized payment visibility: Customers can access invoices and payment requests from one account and quickly identify what is outstanding, overdue or complete.
  • Detailed invoice review: Customers can review amounts, dates and line-item details before making a payment.
  • Integrated agreements: When an agreement is required, customers can review and sign it as part of the payment process instead of managing a separate workflow.
  • Card and bank payments powered by Fractal: Payment information is securely handled within the Fractal payment experience.
  • Customer team management: Account administrators can invite team members and manage access, while individual users can be scoped to the transactions relevant to them.
  • Merchant branding: The portal reflects the supplier's branding, keeping the supplier at the center of the customer experience.
  • Automatic SkyOS synchronization: Online payments, offline payments, canceled transactions and deleted transactions remain aligned between the portal and SkyOS.

Expanding the SkyOS Ecosystem

The Contractor Portal also marks a larger strategic step for Sky Systemz as the company expands deeper into the construction value chain.

By creating technology for the businesses purchasing from construction materials suppliers—not only the suppliers themselves—SkyOS creates a new connection between the two sides of the industry's payment ecosystem.

That connection creates opportunities to solve more of the operational fragmentation that exists between suppliers, contractors and their teams as invoices, agreements, payments and financial information move between organizations.

"Our vision for SkyOS has never been to build another isolated piece of software," Nichols added. "The opportunity is to connect the systems, workflows and businesses that keep construction moving. Supporting our customers' customers is a major step in creating value in that connected ecosystem."

The SkyOS Contractor Portal launched today and is now available to customers nationwide.

To learn more or schedule a demonstration of the SkyOS Contractor Portal, visit SkySystemz.com.

About Sky Systemz

Sky Systemz is a Lexington, Kentucky-based financial technology and software company building technology for the construction and heavy building materials industry. Its flagship platform, SkyOS, is a modular operating system designed to simplify complex business operations by connecting payments, customer management, transactions and other essential workflows in one ecosystem.

Through its partnership with Fractal, Sky Systemz is working to modernize construction payments and financial technology while helping businesses reduce complexity, protect margins and create more connected experiences across the industry.

Learn more at SkySystemz.com and follow Sky Systemz on LinkedIn.

About Fractal

Fractal is a financial technology company modernizing how businesses accept, manage and move money. Through secure, integrated payment technology, Fractal helps construction and other complex industries simplify payment workflows, reduce friction and create more connected financial experiences.

Fractal powers payments across the SkyOS ecosystem, giving suppliers and their customers secure ways to complete card and bank transactions within the workflows they already use.

Learn more at FractalPay.com and follow Fractal on LinkedIn.

releases.title: Marie-Mai hosts L'Accolade, Leucan's new podcast
releases.body:
A platform for families to share their experiences with pediatric cancer

MONTRÉAL, Sept. 1, 2026 /CNW/ -- Leucan and Marie-Mai are proud to announce the launch of L'Accolade, Leucan's new French-language podcast. The four-episode series features conversations with adolescents, young adults and parents about their experiences with pediatric cancer. All four episodes of L'Accolade are now available in French on Leucan's website and YouTube channel, as well as on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

Marie-Mai, Leucan's spokesperson since 2016, hosts each hour-long episode. The launch coincides with the beginning of Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, observed each September.

L'Accolade addresses the wide-ranging impacts of pediatric cancer, including psychosocial needs, financial insecurity, clinical research, self-esteem, resilience, and the loss of a child.

"As Leucan's spokesperson for the past 10 years, I have had the privilege of meeting many families, and every encounter has stayed with me in a different way," says Marie-Mai. "I wanted to deepen my commitment through a project that would allow me to listen--to understand how pediatric cancer can change a family and a life. Despite the seriousness of the issues discussed, what has struck me most is the remarkable strength and spirit of these families. Beyond the lasting effects of illness, I wanted their voices to be heard."

A resource for families affected by pediatric cancer

The title L'Accolade, French for "the embrace," reflects Leucan's commitment to supporting families without judgment at every stage of their journey.

Juli Meilleur, Leucan's executive director, is featured in one episode. As the mother of a child who has recovered from three cancers, she brings both professional and personal perspectives to the conversation.

"Pediatric cancer is often discussed through statistics or fundraising campaigns. With this podcast, we are giving a face and a voice to the realities we encounter every day at Leucan," says Meilleur. "I also take part as a Leucan parent. From the moment a diagnosis is announced, families often need to hear from others who have been through a similar journey. That is the space we have created with this podcast."

Four episodes, four inspiring stories

  • Episode 1: Turning adversity into a mission, with Juli Meilleur
  • Episode 2: Cancer, blindness and a new country: rebuilding as a teenager, with Anoushka
  • Episode 3: Research, resilience and laughter, with Véronic
  • Episode 4: Facing the unimaginable: the loss of a child, with Sabrina-Claudia

About Leucan

For more than 48 years, Leucan has supported children with cancer and their families from the time of diagnosis and throughout every stage of the illness. Through a qualified team with recognized expertise in pediatric cancer, the Association provides specialized, tailored services to hundreds of families and thousands of members across Quebec.

Leucan also funds clinical research and operates the Leucan Information Centre, helping families access reliable information and support throughout their child's cancer journey. With seven offices across the province, Leucan is there for families throughout Quebec.

BEIJING, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Swedish rock band The Cardigans led the lineup of nine international acts and 15 Chinese artists at the fifth Xiami Music & Arts Festival, held from Aug. 28 to 30, 2026. The three-day festival, themed "Life is not a track, but a ______," drew tens of thousands of fans to Aranya, a coastal cultural and tourism destination in northern China's Hebei province.

Co-produced by Damai Entertainment, an Alibaba Group subsidiary, and Aranya, and organized by Damai's Xiami Music Entertainment label, the festival has become one of China's major destination music events. Over the past five years, it has brought 33 international acts to China, introducing Chinese audiences to a broader range of music from around the world while providing overseas artists and music brands with a gateway to the Chinese market.

This year's international lineup featured artists from Sweden, the United States, the United Kingdom and Australia, including The Cardigans, Tortoise, The Horrors, Frente!, Gallant, Hayd, Christian Kuria, Ivoris and Zella Day. They performed alongside Chinese artists including Lao Lang, Chen Li and Leah Dou in a lineup spanning indie pop, post-rock, alternative rock, R&B and dream pop.

The Cardigans delivered a special 90-minute set featuring songs from across their three-decade career, including "Lovefool," "Communication" and "Carnival."

In recent years, the festival has expanded beyond music to include theater, exhibitions, film, designer toys and other forms of entertainment, becoming a showcase for Damai Entertainment's broader live entertainment portfolio. At this year's event, Damai Entertainment's designer-toy brand LUCKY LOOP showcased original characters including HEY PENNY, ECHOA and Kooie. The brand opened its first three stores—in Shanghai, Shenzhen and Guangzhou—in August and plans to establish a presence in six Chinese cities by the end of the year.

The festival also highlighted the growing connections between Damai Entertainment's live entertainment and film businesses. The theme song and closing theme from the hit film Dear You were performed during the event. Damai Entertainment is also handling the film's worldwide theatrical release.

The festival's commercial program continued to grow in 2026, with 30 brands participating, including 88VIP, Samsung, Volkswagen, Tmall Hey Box, Tmall Super Brand Day, Sprite, Aimer, Freshippo and Nivea. Over the past five years, the festival has worked with 61 brand clients, 18 of which have returned for additional partnerships, representing a repeat-partnership rate of nearly 30%.

Environmental initiatives have also become an integral part of the festival's operations. Over the past five years, it has established 500 waste-sorting stations, collected more than 300,000 plastic bottles and engaged over 300,000 attendees in environmental initiatives.

About Damai Entertainment

Damai Entertainment is a technology-driven company delivering immersive, real-world entertainment experiences. Its diverse ecosystem spans film production, live events, IP commercialization, TV series, artist management, and ticketing platforms. Anchored in its dual strategic pillars of entertainment and AI, Damai is committed to creating unparalleled live, interactive, and immersive experiences for audiences around the world.

releases.title: Influencer Advantage Surpasses 75,000 Monthly Creator Partnerships, Expands Scale of Creator-Led Performance Marketing
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Influencer Advantage has surpassed 75,000 creator partnerships activated each month, marking a significant milestone as brands increasingly adopt creator-led performance marketing to drive measurable business growth. The achievement reflects the company's continued investment in building the infrastructure that connects creators, brands, creative strategy, paid media, and performance data into a unified customer acquisition system.

Unlike traditional influencer marketing campaigns that often prioritize reach and engagement, Influencer Advantage focuses on helping ecommerce and consumer brands identify the creators, messages, and content that generate measurable business results. Its proprietary Creator Marketplace now includes more than 400,000 creators and supports the production of more than 200,000 performance creative assets each month. The company also manages more than $850 million in annual advertising spend across a portfolio of more than 700 active brands.

The milestone comes as many brands rethink how they approach influencer marketing. Rising advertising costs, faster creative fatigue, and increasingly automated advertising platforms have made it more difficult for marketers to rely on a handful of creators or isolated campaigns. Instead, many companies are shifting toward larger creator ecosystems that continuously test new content, audiences, and messaging before scaling the strongest performers.

Influencer Advantage was built around that model. Rather than treating influencer marketing as a series of one-off collaborations, the company integrates creator sourcing, creative strategy, performance content production, creator whitelisting, affiliate partnerships, paid media, and performance analysis into one operating system. Each campaign produces new data that helps guide future creative decisions, allowing brands to improve performance over time instead of starting from scratch with every campaign.

"The old model asked brands to find one perfect influencer," said James Gray, Founder of Influencer Advantage. "We would rather test hundreds of creators, measure the results, and let performance data identify the combinations that deserve to scale."

The company's proprietary Creator Marketplace plays a central role in that process. Instead of manually recruiting creators for every campaign, brands gain access to a structured marketplace that matches products with creators based on category, audience, demographics, creator style, and historical performance. The marketplace also streamlines contracting, content production, usage rights, creator whitelisting, approvals, and reporting, helping brands launch campaigns more efficiently.

Beyond creator scale, Influencer Advantage emphasizes what it calls meaningful creative diversity. Rather than producing multiple versions of the same advertisement, campaigns are built around different customer personas, creator styles, emotional angles, product benefits, and stages of the customer journey. This approach allows brands to generate a broader range of creative insights while reducing the effects of creative fatigue.

Those insights become increasingly valuable as campaigns grow. The company analyzes billions of creator, campaign, and performance data points to identify patterns that help determine which creators, creative concepts, messages, and audience combinations are most likely to succeed. The objective is not to replace human creativity but to strengthen decision-making through measurable performance data.

"Real people create the content," James Gray added. "Our data helps us understand why it works, so every campaign contributes to stronger performance in the future."

Influencer Advantage's operating model also reflects broader changes taking place across digital advertising. As paid media platforms continue to automate audience targeting, creative quality and authentic creator content have become increasingly important drivers of campaign performance. Brands are placing greater emphasis on testing diverse creator partnerships and amplifying the highest-performing content rather than relying solely on organic reach or follower counts.

The company's integrated approach allows brands to move from creator discovery to campaign activation in less time while maintaining continuous testing and optimization throughout the customer acquisition process. By connecting marketplace activity, creative production, paid media, and performance analysis, Influencer Advantage helps organizations build repeatable systems for long-term growth rather than isolated marketing campaigns.

As creator-led commerce continues to evolve, the company expects brands to invest more heavily in scalable creator ecosystems supported by measurable performance data. Surpassing 75,000 monthly creator partnerships represents both a company milestone and a reflection of the growing demand for performance-focused creator marketing that delivers accountable business outcomes.

About Influencer Advantage

Influencer Advantage is a creator-led performance marketing company that helps ecommerce and consumer brands build creator-powered customer acquisition systems. Through its proprietary Creator Marketplace, Creative Strategy Flywheel, performance creative operation, creator whitelisting, affiliate programs, paid media expertise, and performance analysis, the company helps brands identify winning creators and messages before scaling them profitably. Today, Influencer Advantage works with more than 700 active brands, supports more than $850 million in annual advertising spend, activates approximately 75,000 creator partnerships each month, and produces more than 200,000 performance creative assets monthly.

To learn more visit: https://influenceradvantage.com/

Custom integrators can also outfit the C2 with a fully customizable frame through SKYWORTH's partnership with hydroframes, available in black, silver, gold, white, and walnut, or in any custom pattern or color, with simple one-step installation over the TV's existing bezel.

"From Palette to Pixel: Illuminate Life with Art"

Michael Gleason, Director of Sales, SKYWORTH USA, commented on the significance of the C2 debut, noting: "For years, the Art TV category has required consumers to accept a frustrating compromise: sacrifice visual depth and image quality for a beautiful frame. The industry standard expected buyers to settle for flat, edge-lit QLED panels that function well as ambient art but wash out the moment the lights go down for cinematic viewing.  Our C2 Canvas Art® TV shatters this paradigm by establishing a definitive new standard for Art TVs. Rather than lowering our technical specifications to meet the competition, we integrated the advanced display DNA of our flagship CE1 Canvas Elite™ Art TV into our standard Canvas Art® lineup. The result is a magnificent display that literally leaves the competition in the dust."

SKYWORTH C2 Canvas Art® TV: The New Standard for Masterpiece Displays

While the Canvas Elite™ Art TV remains the no-expense-spared showcase of absolute luxury with the highest specs available, by bringing such elite features as QD-Mini LED technology and the OmniView Matte Screen™ directly to standard Art TVs, the C2 truly transcends its category.

Specs at a Glance:

  • 144Hz refresh rate
  • 400+ full-array local dimming zones
  • 1,000 nits of peak brightness
  • True HDR10+ and Dolby Vision support
  • Built-in subwoofer with Dolby Atmos – no external soundbar required

The result is a hybrid of gallery-ready aesthetic design and high-quality performance. Far from the stripped-down display typical of standard Art TVs, the SKYWORTH C2 Canvas Art® TV is a complete restoration of texture, shadow, and emotion, proving that the modern living room does not have to choose between art and engineering.

C2 Upgrades the Canvas Art® Portfolio

In addition to the new Canvas C2, the Canvas Art® line includes the C1 available in 75-, 55-, and 65-inch models. This comprehensive range ensures custom integrators can offer clients the perfect size for any space while maintaining the signature blend of 4K entertainment and artistic display capabilities that has made the Canvas series a favorite among discerning homeowners.

Availability and Pricing

SKYWORTH will debut the C2 Canvas Art® TV at the CEDIA Expo 2026 (Booth 2923). The new line will be available through SKYWORTH's authorized custom integration dealer network.  Pricing and availability details will be announced at CEDIA.

About SKYWORTH

SKYWORTH USA is the North American division of SKYWORTH Group, a global electronics leader founded in 1988 and headquartered in Shenzhen. Built on a foundation of innovation, quality, and sustainability, SKYWORTH USA provides a comprehensive portfolio of display solutions designed with industry-leading visual technology. By engineering products for a variety of applications, SKYWORTH USA ensures high-performance viewing experiences are accessible for every space.

HBO Max partnership expands "The Howard Stern Show" distribution to world-wide

TORONTO, Aug. 31, 2026 /CNW/ -- Howard Stern and SiriusXM Canada today announced the new season of The Howard Stern Show, with new shows airing every Monday, starting on September 14. 

For the first time, the "King of All Media" will bring his signature, long-running SiriusXM show to HBO Max by adapting his live SiriusXM show into a streamable episode for HBO Max, along with periodic extras. The Howard Stern Show on HBO Max will debut Thursday September 17, with new episodes releasing subsequent Thursdays.

Since joining SiriusXM for a legendary run of over 20 years, Howard has taken subscribers and fans on an unprecedented journey. He is regularly lauded as the best interviewer of our time, inspiration for a generation of comedy, and a can't-miss listen. During his time with SiriusXM, his fans were along for his climb to network television as a judge on America's Got Talent, and the best-seller list as author of "Howard Stern Comes Again." Critics and fans alike loved Howard's 2022 interview with Bruce Springsteen on HBO Max. Today, Howard's new series on HBO Max takes him to the pinnacle of prestige television and gives his fans a long-desired "seat in the studio" to see what they just heard. As fans hear his live show on SiriusXM, 40 cameras will capture the conversation for a version of the show then adapted into a streamable episode for HBO Max with periodic extras.

"There's simply no one like Howard, and the start of his new season is another exciting chapter in an extraordinary run," said Scott Greenstein, SiriusXM's President and Chief Content Officer. "For more than two decades at SiriusXM, he's continued to evolve, surprise audiences and deliver the kind of conversations and moments that only Howard can. We are proud that Howard chose to continue with SiriusXM through 2028 for his exclusive live show and deep library of classic Howard, and that Howard, HBO Max and SiriusXM have now teamed up to create a compelling new video version of his show." 

Additionally on September 14, Howard will unveil a new lineup for his long-time SiriusXM channel Howard 100, including Wrap Up Wednesday, an expanded version of Howard's Wrap Up Show hosted by Gary Dell'Abate and Jon Hein, plus new ways to hear his multi-decade library of past shows. The Howard Stern section of the SiriusXM app is also expanding to include "Howard Stern Decades" for instant access to Howard's content from, or about, the 80's, 90's, 00's and 10's.  

Howard's legions of long-time and new fans never miss a minute of The Howard Stern Show, tuning in to catch all of Howard's comedy, conversations, and commentary with his beloved team including Robin Quivers, Fred Norris and Gary Dell'Abate, the antics of his staff and producers, and regular visits from top celebrities and musicians. Recent guests include Ben Affleck and Matt Damon, Eric Andre, Jack Antonoff, Nikki Glaser, Kate Hudson, Taylor Sheridan, David Spade, Sting & Shaggy, Karl-Anthony Towns, and Eddie Vedder.

The Howard Stern Show is available to SiriusXM subscribers in their car, on their phone and connected devices at home with the SiriusXM app.

releases.title: Boynton Beach Agency Says the Smartest Ad Buy in 2026 Is Not an Ad: Good At Marketing Bets on Earned Media Odds With Proprietary Software No Other Agency Has
releases.body:
While competitors bid up the same paid channels, Google Partner agency Good At Marketing has built exclusive in house software that wins its clients real press coverage, the kind money is not supposed to be able to buy.

BOYNTON BEACH, Fla., Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Every business in South Florida can buy an ad tomorrow. Almost none of them will be quoted in the press this year. Good At Marketing, a Boynton Beach based Google Partner agency, says that difference is the most mispriced opportunity in marketing, and it has built proprietary software to exploit it.

The math the agency points to is about trust and odds. Nielsen's long running Global Trust in Advertising research has consistently found that consumers trust recommendations and editorial media far more than any paid format, with roughly nine in ten trusting earned recommendations while paid digital ads rank near the bottom of the list. Meanwhile AI assistants, which a growing share of buyers now consult before purchasing, build their answers from the same earned record: press mentions, expert commentary, and independent coverage.

"Paid channels are a vending machine," said Donnie Strompf, the agency's founder. "You put money in, an ad comes out, and everyone can see it is an ad, including the AI your customer asks for advice. Earned media is the opposite. You cannot simply buy it, the odds of landing it on your own are terrible, and that is exactly why it is worth more. A business owner might send fifty pitches to get one quote placed. We built software that changes those odds, and we are the only ones who have it."

The agency will not describe how the system works. It says that is the point.

"It is proprietary, it is exclusive to our clients, and it stays that way," Strompf said. "What I will describe is what a client experiences. Real journalists writing real stories quote them, their expertise shows up in outlets they did not pitch, and the AI assistants their customers use start citing them as the authority in their category. The client's entire job is to approve with one tap. We handle everything else."

The agency reports that client placements now span national business, marketing, and trade publications, with local clients ranging from law firms to home service companies to ecommerce brands.

The offering is deliberately capped, the agency says. "Exclusive means exclusive. We are not selling this to everyone, and we are certainly not selling it to two competitors in the same market," Strompf said.

South Florida businesses can learn more at goodatmarketing.com.

About Good At Marketing

Good At Marketing is a Google Partner marketing agency based in Boynton Beach, Florida, founded by Donnie Strompf in 2017. The agency runs performance marketing, search, and earned media programs for businesses across the United States. Learn more at goodatmarketing.com.

releases.title: ESI Named ENR's 2026 Intermountain Contractor of the Year
releases.body:
BOISE, Idaho, Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- When Engineering News-Record named Engineered Structures Inc. (ESI) its 2026 Contractor of the Year for the Intermountain region, the recognition reflected more than the scale of the company's recent projects. It recognized a contractor that has spent decades building a reputation for complex work, strong customer relationships, employee development, and long-term investment in the communities where it operates.

The award covers ESI's work across Idaho, Utah, and Montana—three states where the company has continued to grow while maintaining its roots in the Intermountain West.

For ESI, the recognition is ultimately a reflection of the people behind the projects.

A Regional Contractor with a Growing Reach

ESI's evolution from a regional contractor into one of the nation's larger construction firms has been built on a willingness to take on increasingly complex work without losing sight of the relationships that made that growth possible.

Today, ESI ranks among the nation's largest contractors, placing No. 105 on Engineering News-Record's 2026 Top 400 Contractors list. The company generated more than $850 million in Mountain States revenue in 2025, demonstrating the scale of its presence throughout the region.

That growth has come through a diverse portfolio spanning commercial, education, advanced technology, industrial, mission-critical, and other specialized environments.

But scale alone does not explain the Contractor of the Year recognition.

The award reflects ESI's ability to bring that experience to projects that are helping shape the future of the communities where the company works.

Building Projects That Shape the Region

Some of ESI's most visible recent work demonstrates the range and complexity of that responsibility.

In Boise, ESI is constructing office and parking structures as part of Micron's global headquarters expansion—work connected to one of the largest economic and technological developments in Idaho. The company is also completing major higher-education projects for the College of Western Idaho, including the Health and Science Building, which opened in 2025.

Other projects, such as The Chancery in downtown Boise, demonstrate ESI's role in transforming existing urban environments and contributing to the continued growth of the region's communities. ENR specifically highlighted the Micron expansion, the College of Western Idaho Health and Science Building, and The Chancery among the projects contributing to this year's recognition.

These projects are different in purpose, scale, and complexity. Together, however, they illustrate an important part of ESI's approach: the ability to adapt its expertise to the needs of each customer and each community.

Whether building an educational facility, supporting advanced technology infrastructure, or helping transform a downtown neighborhood, the work carries consequences that extend well beyond the construction site.

Success Starts with People

Behind every project is a workforce capable of delivering it.

That has remained central to ESI's identity as the company has grown. "Everyone Succeeds Together" is ESI's stated purpose, reflecting a belief that long-term success depends on creating an environment where employees, customers, trade partners, and communities can succeed together.

That purpose becomes particularly important as construction projects become more sophisticated and the industry continues to face challenges around workforce development.

ESI has invested in developing employees at every stage of their careers, creating opportunities for people to gain experience in the field, grow into leadership roles, and build careers within the company.

The result is a culture where experience is passed from one generation of employees to the next—helping the company take on more complicated projects while maintaining the knowledge and relationships that have supported its growth.

The ENR recognition is therefore not simply a measure of what ESI has built in the past year. It is also a reflection of the people who have helped build the company itself.

Growing Without Losing Its Roots

As ESI's geographic reach has expanded, its connection to the Intermountain West has remained an important part of its identity.

The company has continued to invest in the communities where its employees live and where its projects are built. That investment can be seen through its work in education, workforce development, charitable giving, and community partnerships.

The approach reflects a broader understanding of what it means to be a contractor in a growing

region.

Construction companies do more than construct buildings. They help create the schools where students learn, the facilities where businesses grow, the infrastructure communities rely on, and the places where people live and work.

ESI's recent portfolio reflects that responsibility. Its projects are helping accommodate population growth, support emerging industries, expand educational opportunities, and create new economic activity across the region.

That combination of growth and investment has become an important part of ESI's continued evolution. The company has grown dramatically from its early days, but its expansion has not changed the principles that have guided it throughout that journey: developing people, building strong relationships, delivering for customers, and investing in the communities it serves.

Being named ENR's 2026 Intermountain Contractor of the Year is recognition of how those principles have translated into results.

From major developments in downtown Boise to new educational facilities and the expansion of one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, ESI is contributing to some of the most significant construction projects in the Intermountain West.

The buildings may be the most visible evidence of that work, but they are only part of the story.

Behind them is an organization capable of bringing together thousands of people, decades of experience, and a shared commitment to building something that lasts.

For ESI, being named ENR's Intermountain Contractor of the Year is recognition of that work—and of the people and communities that make it possible.

releases.title: Sunny Hostin Signs with Fountain 0 to License Her Image for Appearances in Upcoming Films Which She Looks to Produce Based on Her Best-Selling Books
releases.body:
Fountain 0 Calls for Influencers with Major Social Media Followings to Join the Fountain 0 Talent Directory to be Eligible to Earn from Licensing Their Images

NEW YORK, Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fountain 0 announced that Sunny Hostin, co-anchor of the acclaimed daily talk show The View, would become the first major personality to agree to develop and produce one or more films, and license her image and likeness for purposes of those films to the leading AI film and tv studio.

Fountain 0, which produced the first full length, live action film to be accepted at a major film festival, when it premiered at The Tribeca Film Festival last month, has also announced the release of its newest film, Odysseus: The Fall, in the very near future. The studio has gotten very significant national press for having produced content at a quality level comparable to traditional productions.

Odysseus: The Fall is using images of real people in the film, including Ash Koosha, the film's creator and CEO of Fountain 0 as Odysseus; Pooya Koosha, co-producer and co-founder of Fountain 0, as Eurylochus; and Tom Rogers, Executive Chairman of Fountain 0 and executive producer of the film, as Mentor.

Having demonstrated that the proprietary software and virtual production studio that Fountain 0 has built on top of AI video models is capable of reducing production costs to nominal levels while achieving the highest of quality productions, it has set its sights on ways to reduce marketing and promotion costs of its films. Along these lines, a key innovation that Fountain 0 intends to pursue is licensing the images of well-known personalities and influencers to represent characters in upcoming productions as a way to efficiently market releases to their followers. It has been proven for decades that recognizable personalities in films drive audience appeal, and to combine that with the power of social media relevance creates a formula to better enable audiences to know about films that incorporate the image of those they follow.

Sunny Hostin could not be a more perfect example of a very well-known figure to pioneer this new approach to incorporating the likenesses of key personalities into new films. Sunny not only has heavily devoted fans who enjoy her political, social, legal and cultural television commentary, while also having a major social media presence, but she is also a New York Times bestselling author, having written several books of fiction. In that regard, Sunny intends to bring her novels to the big screen through the industry leading AI film production capability of Fountain 0, while incorporating her own image in the film.

Ash Koosha stated, "This is obviously new territory for major talent personalities. We are incredibly gratified that Sunny is willing to be the talent pioneer willing to step out and take advantage of this new form of creative expression. Sunny, of course, will be able to decide which of her works she develops into a film, and what roles her image can be incorporated into under a licensing agreement which gives her strict control over how her image can be used."

Sunny Hostin stated, "I am thrilled to be a part of how top-quality AI productions cannot only enable writers and directors to have their imaginations unleashed and no longer be tethered to budgetary constraints, but I am excited to be able to help pioneer a new art form which can open up new dimensions for how public personalities can engage with audiences."

Sunny Hostin, continued, "To be able to bring my novels to life in movie and TV form, and actually have my image inserted in the productions, so that audiences can relate to me through my stories beyond my role as an author, is incredibly exciting to me. This entire generational innovation in filmmaking from Fountain 0 gives me confidence that AI can give me a way to both more fully develop, and more fully immerse myself in, IP I have developed. I feel particularly strongly that there is a need to bring stories to the big screen that are more in tune with the lives of diverse audiences that Hollywood focuses too little on, and I believe Fountain 0's AI productions can have a major impact on responding to the interests of these underserved audiences."

Pooya Koosha, also post- producer of the films, stated, "Our ability to refine image generation to not only present the physical likeness of a personality, but to match their voice and other characteristics will give fans a real sense that their favorite talents are actually present in the productions despite the fact that they will be synthetic images."

Tom Rogers stated, "Our approach is to make sure all persons whose images are used in any Fountain 0 production are compensated by receiving a revenue participation in the film. Even small parts which might not involve incorporating major personalities will participate in the revenue generated by any film for which their image is used.

Rogers continued, "With Sunny not only being a personality in front of the camera, but an author as well, we look forward to the potential to develop films based on her books. Writers and directors will have quite significant revenue participation in the productions they create. In that sense Sunny will participate as both a producer/writer in the revenue generated from any film but also participate in the film's upside from her image appearing in the film as well."

Emma Sarah Wilson, Counsel to Fountain 0, said the company has developed a comprehensive licensing framework governing the use of an individual's image. Wilson explained, "We have developed a robust long-form licensing agreement for every individual whose image, likeness and voice may be used in a Fountain 0 production. The agreement provides clear consent and usage rights, while establishing safeguards for how reference images and voice recordings are stored and used within the studio and its projects. Our goal is to protect each individual's privacy and control over their identity while preserving the creative flexibility and technical quality required to produce the highest quality image and voice generation."

Ash Koosha called for all influencers and those with major social media followings to join the Fountain 0 talent directory from which their likeness can be licensed. He stated, "If one's image or likeness is licensed with approval, a person becomes eligible to earn from what will be a fountain of film and tv episodes." Sign up here https://join.fountain0.com. 

Dreams of Violets is now streaming at Watch.Fountain0.com, and the trailer for Odysseus: The Fall is also available on the site as well. Interested viewers can sign up now to be on the list for advanced viewing of Odysseus: The Fall, scheduled for release next month.

releases.title: A Voice Across the World: Hokkien Music & Culture Concert Gives New Voice to a Thousand-Year-Old Tradition Heritage
releases.body:
Sold-out Huizhou premiere marks the first YUELAIMEI Hokkien-language song concert staged in mainland China outside the language's place of origin

HUIZHOU, China, Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On the evening of August 21, the Hokkien Music & Culture Global Tour • 2026 Original Hokkien Song Concert took the stage at the Opera House of the Huizhou Culture and Art Center in Guangdong, China. Tickets sold out the moment they went on sale, filling all 1,300-plus seats in the hall. The performance was streamed live to audiences worldwide.

Hokkien is one of the 60 major world languages recognized by the United Nations. It originated in the southern Fujian Province and the eastern Guangdong Province in China. Hokkien speakers are a maritime people, distinct in culture from the land-based traditions of China's other communities. The language carries a thousand years of seafaring, exploration, and migration. Through the ports of Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, Xiamen, and Zhanglin in Shantou, Hokkien culture took root across Fujian and Guangdong, linked both sides of Taiwan, China, and spread far overseas. Today, the language faces a generational break in transmission among young people. With several hundred thousand Hokkien speakers living in Huizhou, efforts to revitalize the mother tongue carry real urgency here.

From Boston to Huizhou

The event was initiated by Hokkien Music & Culture, founded by Jiayu (Kitty) Huang, whose family home is in Huizhou. Raised by elders who insisted she keep her mother tongue, she went on to study in Massachusetts from a young age, training in composition and music production under noted professors from the New England Conservatory and Berklee College of Music. She began writing and producing music in sixth grade and has since contributed to several hundred works; in tenth grade, she received an Honorable Mention from the Massachusetts Composition Competition. She completed her undergraduate studies at the Thornton School of Music at the University of Southern California, where she founded and led the university's only Chinese traditional music ensemble. An advocate for Hokkien language preservation as a public-interest cause, she established Hokkien Music & Culture in the Hollywood district of Los Angeles in 2023 to promote and pass on Hokkien culture through music.

Hokkien Music & Culture's work spans music composition, record releases, and cultural promotion. The company regularly organizes Hokkien-language preservation events, including songwriting and literary competitions, concerts, cultural symposia, and academic paper awards. It also publishes and promotes Hokkien songs and literature with the aim of developing new talent in both fields. Since 2024, Hokkien Music & Culture has run a global Hokkien songwriting competition and a worldwide concert tour out of Los Angeles, drawing on charitable support to protect and grow the mother tongue.

Three Generations on One Stage

The concert brought together scholars of Hokkien culture from China and abroad, veteran musicians, and inheritors of intangible cultural heritage, with performers spanning three generations. Zhang Shenghuan, associate professor at the School of Music of Jimei University, wove Gaojia Opera vocal technique into her songs. Xiamen TV host Chen Xiaoyuan and UFO Records signed artist Zheng Lili performed several Hokkien classics songs. Huizhou's own heritage traditions were represented by Zhang Xiying, vice chair of the municipal musicians' association, who folded elements of Huidong fishermen's songs into her Hokkien performance. Shantou musician Jiang Shengxin, Teochew singer Du Weikun, Xiamen vocalists Zeng Zhichao and Chen Shuna, and Shantou singer Lin Yini shared the stage with the Huizhou Mengshen Chorus, passing the songs of home from one generation of musicians to the next.

The program balanced new original work with beloved standards. Winning entries from the 2024 and 2025 editions of the Global Hokkien Songwriting Competition were performed, including "Over Rivers and Mountains to Baizhang Stream," "A New Shirt," "Kapok," and "Take It Easy" — new melodies telling Hokkien stories. Familiar classics such as "Don't Lose Heart," "Old Love Lingers On," "Sea Waves," and "Words After Drinking" were presented in fresh arrangements. The Mengshen Chorus performed "Longing for the Spring Breeze" and "When the Flower Leaves the Branch," showcasing the warmth and quiet strength of the Hokkien songbook and drawing a strong emotional response from the audience.

Organizers and Academic Support

The concert was presented by Hokkien Music & Culture, with the Huizhou Dongjiang Hokkien Culture Research Association and Yifan Yinghua Culture Communication (Xiamen) Co., Ltd. as co-organizers. Hokkien Music & Culture (USA) and the Chinese Musicians Association of Boston supported international outreach. The evening was hosted in three languages—Hokkien, Mandarin, and English—and streamed live worldwide, carrying Hokkien culture beyond geographic borders. Scholars of the Hokkien language include Zhou Changji of Xiamen University and Dong Zhongsi of National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, and Gan Yu'en of Jinan University served as cultural advisors, lending academic weight to the preservation effort.

Reception

The concert was a resounding success. It is understood to be the first Hokkien-language song concert ever staged in mainland China outside the language's place of origin, and major media outlets gave it extensive coverage. Zhou Changji, professor at Xiamen University and a leading authority on Hokkien culture in China, attended the performance. He said it was the most stirring Hokkien song concert he had seen in his life, praising the high caliber of the performers and the deeply moving response from the audience—proof, he said, of how much the mother tongue still means to the people who came.

Looking Ahead

Following two editions of the Global Hokkien Songwriting Competition in 2024 and 2025 and the 2025–2026 Hokkien Music & Culture Original Hokkien Song Global Tour, with stops in Boston, USA, and Huizhou, China, the company will continue to invest in Hokkien music creation and expand its channels of distribution at home and abroad, bringing new life to a thousand-year-old culture in a new era.

About Hokkien Music & Culture

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, Hokkien Music & Culture works in music composition, record releases, and cultural promotion, with a mission to preserve and revitalize the Hokkien language through songwriting competitions, concerts, publications, and academic programs.

BERKELEY, Calif., Aug. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ahead of IBC Show 2026, Eluvio today announced that Cricket Australia has launched Cricket TV, a new direct-to-consumer streaming service built upon Eluvio's Content Fabric and AI Video Intelligence, extending Cricket Australia's live and archival programming to fans beyond its existing broadcast markets across the globe. Cricket TV is now available for early access with full commercial launch of the service expected later this year at https://tv.cricket.com.au.

"We're excited to extend our partnership with Eluvio as we continue to grow Cricket TV and make Australian cricket more accessible to fans around the world," said Dan Allan, Senior Content Manager, Broadcast at Cricket Australia. "Cricket TV brings live matches and some of the best moments from our archive together in one place for fans around the world. Eluvio has been a fantastic partner throughout the process, helping us deliver a high-quality viewing experience while giving us the flexibility to keep evolving the platform. During the early access period, Cricket TV has already reached viewers in more than 40 countries, highlighting the strong global interest in Australian cricket."

"We're honored to have extended our relationship with Cricket Australia, not only to serve their fans with live matches, but also to serve as a model for other sports organizations looking for the most efficient and cost-effective way to deliver protected sports content with the quality today's global viewers deserve," said Michelle Munson, CEO and Co-founder, Eluvio. "With one Fabric, sports rights holders can unlock dark markets and monetize live and VOD and leverage frame-accurate inline AI, without file copies— all at a fraction of legacy costs while retaining full control of their customers' experience and viewer analytics."

A Unified Platform for Streaming and AI Video Intelligence

Cricket TV provides a white-label browser, mobile, and connected TV application to its viewers built using the Eluvio Media Wallet platform (full turnkey OTT Suite). Cricket TV relies on Eluvio's Content Fabric to receive live matches or archival source feeds and dynamically ingests, transcodes, publishes and generates just-in-time streaming output directly to viewers. Streaming is provided at full source resolution, including HD and 4K, with dynamic automatic adaptation to the user's available bandwidth with low latency HLS/DASH delivery, unlimited multi-view, "zero-copy" live-to-VoD and fast DVR playback. The platform also provides subscriptions, pay-per-view, and/or ad-supported monetization, while providing end-to-end content security and anti-piracy protection including strong encryption, DRM, forensic watermarking, and dynamic authorization per-offering including geo blocking and rights control. All features are built-in allowing for a hyper-efficient, tamper-proof distribution, fast and easy purchasing, and on-screen authenticity proofs for the viewer.

In addition, the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) and AI-assisted tools provide frame-accurate, in-line analysis, indexing, and search, composition, and transformation such as live vertical video, all without file copies or re-transcoding. Finally, Eluvio Content Analytics provides complete transparency of source-to-viewer audience, QoS, and sales analytics. Full details about Eluvio's technical capabilities and benefits can be found at https://eluv.io

Eluvio at IBC Show 2026

During IBC Show 2026 at the RAI Amsterdam, Eluvio will highlight its work with Cricket Australia and showcase the full capabilities of the Content Fabric and Eluvio AI in Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and in the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026. Eluvio's CEO and co-founder, Michelle Munson, will also speak on the Future Tech Zone stage on Sunday, September 13 from 2:00–2:15 p.m. Registration for one-on-one meetings and information about Eluvio's on-site keynote demonstrations at IBC is available at https://ibc.eluv.io.

About Eluvio

Eluvio (https://eluv.io) is solving the generational problems of video over the Internet with its Content Fabric Protocol — transforming the distribution and monetization of premium video and digital media in contrast to legacy cloud workflows and CDNs. Eluvio serves Amazon Studios/MGM, Cricket Australia, European Professional Club Rugby, FOX, SONY, Telstra Broadcast Services, UEFA, United Rugby Championship, Warner Bros., WPALiveTV, WWE, and others. Led by Michelle Munson and Serban Simu, founders and inventors of Aspera, and based in Berkeley, California. Eluvio holds  more than 15 issued US patents and has won multiple NAB Streaming Product of the Year awards, the Seicon Grand Prize, the Hollywood Professional Association Engineering Excellence Award, and other industry honors. On X: @EluvioInc | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/eluv-io

Cricket Australia is the national governing body for the sport of cricket in Australia, responsible for the game at the international, domestic, and grassroots levels, including the Australian Men's and Women's national teams and domestic competitions such as the Sheffield Shield, the WNCL, and the KFC BBL and WBBL. More information is available at cricket.com.au.

releases.title: Futuri Introduces "Automate, Augment, Hold" Framework to Help Sales Leaders Avoid an AI Trust Deficit
releases.body:
Drawing on a year of conversations with roughly 40 enterprise sales leaders, Futuri CEO Daniel Anstandig warns that automating human moments produces a bill that comes due 18 months later.

AUSTIN, Texas, Aug. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Boards, investors, and AI vendors are pressing revenue organizations toward end-to-end automation, and the cost logic is hard to argue with: if a machine can do the task faster and cheaper, why not let it? Futuri's view is that the logic breaks on a distinction most automation roadmaps never make: the difference between a task and a moment. Drawing on a year of conversations with roughly 40 enterprise sales leaders working through the same question, Futuri CEO and co-founder Daniel Anstandig lays out a framework for sorting the two in "Where AI Ends and the Seller Begins."

The framework divides every step of the revenue process into three categories. Automate covers work where only the output matters and human presence adds no customer value: research, first-draft emails, CRM updates, competitive briefs, meeting summaries. Augment covers work where AI does the heavy lifting and a person makes the call. AI drafts the proposal, scores the account, and surfaces the signal; the seller refines, prioritizes, and decides on timing. Hold covers the moments where automation degrades the relationship: discovery calls, negotiations, first meetings with a new champion, recovery conversations, and the hard conversation that delivers unwelcome news. "There's a difference between automating a task and automating a moment," Anstandig writes. "The presence is the whole point. Replace the human and you haven't streamlined the moment; you've eliminated it and put something else in its place that happens to share the same calendar slot."

The cost of sorting wrong is what he calls the trust deficit, a decline that never surfaces in a dashboard, because the activity that replaced the moment still registers as activity. Customers rarely complain; they quietly disengage, and win rates soften for reasons no report explains. "This is the trust deficit, and it's the bill that comes due eighteen months after the automation mandate went out," Anstandig writes. His conclusion is that the sorting, not the software, is now the variable: "Most leaders are willing to automate. What they skip is the sorting." Two companies can run identical stacks, he argues, and "their outcomes will diverge dramatically."

The full framework, including a step-by-step exercise for auditing a live sales process, is available on Anstandig on the Future. For media companies, marketers, and AI leaders, Automate–Augment–Hold is a portable method for any customer-facing workflow, not only sales. Futuri builds on the same principle in TopLine Enterprise, which surrounds sellers with research, prioritization, and preparation while leaving discovery, negotiation, and relationship judgment with the human.

About Daniel Anstandig: Daniel Anstandig is CEO and co-founder of Futuri, where he has spent more than 16 years building AI-powered technology that helps companies transform how they sell, create content, and make decisions. He is also the founder of SparkTrade.io and holds more than 25 patents spanning AI, automation, audio, public safety, and broadcast technology.

About Futuri: Futuri is a global leader in AI technology for sales enablement, data enablement, and content automation. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, Futuri is trusted by 7,000+ companies across 22 countries. Key solutions include TopLine sales intelligence, TopicPulse real-time content trends, Content Automation, AudioAI, SpotOn, and POST. Learn more at Futurimedia.com and Futuri.ai.

releases.body:
New Agency Brings Together OM's Hearts & Science and Mediahub to Create a New 40-Market Global Network

Hearts United debuts as a leader in new business, outperforming its competitors globally and in EMEA, and topping the US ranking 

NEW YORK, Aug. 28, 2026 /CNW/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, today officially launched Hearts United, a new global media agency created through the combination of its Hearts & Science and Mediahub networks.

Bringing together two high-growth challenger organizations with complementary capabilities, cultures and geographic strengths, Hearts United is built to help ambitious brands navigate a media environment where influence moves continuously across platforms, creators, communities, commerce, and AI.

"Hearts & Science helped pioneer data-driven decision-making, while Mediahub broke new ground by proving media could serve as a creative platform," says Omnicom Media CEO Florian Adamski. "In bringing them together as Hearts United, we have created a new globally scaled network built from complementary strengths, approaches and footprints, and grounded in the shared principle of putting client growth at the heart of every decision."

The new agency - which operates across 40 markets and represents approximately $9.1 billion in 2025 billings - launched following sustained growth at both organizations. Between 2021 and 2025, Hearts & Science increased its billings by 50%, while Mediahub grew 33% - momentum that has continued into 2026. As result, the new agency debuts with one of the best new business performances in the industry as tracked by the COMvergence real-time dashboards, currently ranking #1 in the US YTD in total new business (wins minus losses, including retentions), and #3 globally and in EMEA, outperforming agencies that are up to three times its size.

Four principles define the new agency's approach:

  • Outcomes-oriented: An evolving commercial model connects the agency's success with client growth, putting accountability into the operating model.
  • Predictive by design: AI is embedded into workflows and the operating model to expand capacity, strengthen human judgment and give talent more time to solve higher-value problems.
  • Ecosystem mastery: Teams plan holistically across the platforms, communities, creators, and commerce environments where attention and influence move, rather than treating channels as isolated decisions.
  • Focused and senior-led: Expert teams work as extensions of clients' organizations, reducing silos and handoffs while bringing senior guidance and diverse expertise to the work.

Like its sibling Omnicom Media agencies OMD, Initiative, PHD and UM, Hearts United will leverage the singular advantages and assets of the world's largest global media network in scale, data & technology, identity, commerce capabilities, and talent to deliver disproportionate growth for its clients.

Hearts United will be led in the U.S. by Nicole Estebanell, who previously served as CEO of Mediahub U.S., and in EMEA by Ross Jenkins, who led Mediahub across that region. Both leaders bring experience scaling high-growth businesses while maintaining the entrepreneurial cultures and client relationships that drove their success. Their counterparts in APAC and LATAM are expected to be announced in Q4.

Hearts United joins the Omnicom Media agency portfolio as the group has the best 2026 YTD total new business performance among all global media groups for 2026 – including earning more new client billings ($4.1b) than any other group - resulting from a streak of wins including Adidas, Delta, Dyson, IBM, Mark Anthony Brands, Novo Nordisk, On, and Subway.

For more information visit www.heartsunited.com.

About Hearts United

Operating across 40 markets, Omnicom Media agency Hearts United combines media, data, technology, creativity, and commerce to help brands create momentum in a world where people move continuously across platforms, creators, communities, and AI. Built around the belief that growth requires motion, Hearts United was designed to find what others overlook, turn insight into action, and make brands more attention-worthy, crave-worthy, and shop-worthy in an AI-mediated world.

As part of Omnicom Media, the world's largest global media network, Hearts United gives clients the speed, agility and entrepreneurial culture of a challenger agency, combined with Omnicom Media's unparalleled advantages in scale, data, identity, commerce capabilities, and talent. The result is a connected growth system designed to deliver disproportionate impact for ambitious brands, regardless of their size or category.

I am excited for Kim to take our integrated media offering to the next level."

Focused on Media Integration and Innovation

As Head of Integrated Media at FINN, Sizemore is responsible for defining the strategic vision for the integrated media practice; delivering connected solutions for clients across strategy, creative, content, web, PR, SEO/GEO and SEM; driving campaign innovation through data, technology, and emerging platforms, including AI; optimizing team operations; and driving growth for the agency and its clients.

"As the media landscape grows more complex, clients are often hindered by siloed workstreams and deep fragmentation. I believe in the power and clarity that seamless integration between creative and media brings," said Kim Sizemore, Head of Integrated Media at FINN Partners. "FINN shares that same entrepreneurial spirit and openness to crafting bespoke solutions. Throughout my career, I've valued fierce independence and core values as the foundation for creating game-changing work that moves the needle for a client's business. FINN's independent structure gives us the clear runway to build true, unconstrained media solutions that put the client's business impact first."

A Shift in Top Industry Talent

She is genuinely curious and brings a bespoke mindset to every client, regardless of category or budget size. Her decision to join FINN speaks volumes about where the industry is heading. The best talent today is less concerned about the type of agency they work for and more focused on finding places like FINN, where there is more agility, innovation and freedom to solve client problems creatively and holistically."

About FINN Partners

Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has grown from about $24 million in fees to almost $200 million in fees during the past 14 years, becoming one of the fastest-growing independent public relations agencies in the world. Recognized as one of Fast Company's 2024 Most Innovative Companies, PRovoke Media's 2024 Best Agency to Work For and 2022 Agency of the Year, the full-service marketing and communications company's record-setting pace results from organic growth and integrating new companies and new people into the FINN world through a common philosophy. With more than 1,300 professionals across 38 offices, FINN provides clients with global access and capabilities in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Headquartered in New York, FINN has offices in: Abu Dhabi, Atlanta, Bangalore, Bangkok, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Columbus, Delhi, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Fort Lauderdale, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Honolulu, Jerusalem, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Madison, Wisc., Manila, Melbourne, Mumbai, Munich, Nashville, Orange County, Paris, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Singapore, Sydney, Vancouver, Washington D.C. and Yangon. releases.title: UP Argues the Social Media Industry Is Moving From Optional Safeguards Toward Safety by Design
releases.body:
WICHITA, Kan., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Meta's agreement to pay up to $18 billion in aggregate settlements and make significant changes to Facebook and Instagram marks more than a legal turning point. According to UP, Inc., it marks the arrival of a new market category: Safe Social.

The settlement requires Meta to limit users under 18 to two hours per day across Facebook and Instagram, restrict overnight access, reduce notifications during school hours, strengthen age assurance and parental controls, limit visible "likes" and certain filters, and offer young users a non-algorithmic feed option. Several protections can become stricter if other major platforms adopt comparable terms.

The agreement came during Instagram President Adam Mosseri's testimony and before Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg was expected to testify. Meta denied wrongdoing.

"This settlement validates what families have said for years: social media should not be designed to keep people scrolling at any cost," said Nick Rotola, founder and CEO of UP, Inc. "UP began with a more fundamental question: what if safety was not a setting, but the structure of the product?"

Meta has called on TikTok and YouTube to adopt the same framework. UP believes that pressure confirms that safer defaults are becoming an industry expectation, not a discretionary feature.

But UP argues that guardrails added to an engagement-centered platform are not the same as building a platform around safety from the beginning.

UP screens creators and brands before they can publish. Its standards exclude explicit, violent, hateful, substance-promoting, predatory, and manipulative material. UP does not allow unsolicited direct messages or open comments. Its Scroll Happy® system ranks video around how it may leave a viewer feeling, while mood-based feeds provide greater control.

"Meta is being required to add guardrails around an open, engagement-driven network," Rotola said. "UP vets who can publish, curates what enters the feed, removes unsolicited direct messages, and ranks content for how it leaves a person feeling. That is the difference between safety controls and safety by design."

The risk extends beyond screen time. A 2025 Thorn study found that one in five teens surveyed had experienced sextortion. TIME has also reported allegations concerning Meta's former enforcement thresholds and recommendations connecting potentially inappropriate adults with teens. Meta disputed those allegations.

"The press is calling this social media's tobacco moment. I see it as a millstone moment: a reckoning with what happens when products built to capture attention are allowed to shape children before they are ready to defend themselves," Rotola said. "The settlement matters. But a safer version of the same incentive system is not enough. Families deserve a real alternative."

UP calls that alternative Social with Standards.

UP is available as a free download for iPhone and Android. To learn more, visit www.ScrollHappy.com or download UP through the Apple App Store and Google Play.

About UP, Inc.

UP, Inc. is the company behind UP - Scroll Happy®, a social video platform built around vetted creators, curated content, safer interaction, and user well-being. UP gives people an alternative to doomscrolling through Social with Standards.

  • Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon R Movie – Sailor Moon and the Sailor Guardians save Earth from an alien force! Mamoru gave a rose to an alien who helped him with the loss of his parents. His friend has searched for a flower worthy of his gesture, the Xenian flower, which has a very dark side.
  • BLEACH: Hell Verse – Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.

releases.title: FlyersRights Responds to DOT Proposed Roll Back of the Full Fare Advertising Rule
releases.body:
Requests DOT Provide Actual Evidence Justifying the Change

WASHINGTON, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlyersRights submitted comments to the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) in response to its Notice of Proposed Rulemaking titled "Enhancing Flexibility of Air Fare Price Advertising." The proposed rule seeks to either weaken or potentially repeal the 1984 Full Fare Advertising Rule and its 2011 amendments.

The Full Fare Rule, enacted during the Reagan Administration, requires airline advertisements to include the entire price to be paid by a passenger to the airline for a ticket, including taxes and fees. The 1984 rule and the 2011 update were issued in response to complaints of deceptive practices in airfare advertising.

In its public comments, FlyersRights opposed the proposed rulemaking, arguing that the evidence and arguments that the DOT put forward support the status quo or enhanced transparency of all other fees, including optional ancillary fees.

"The same DOT that recently killed the rule to increase transparency in ancillary fees now argues that passengers need transparency into the existence and amount of federal taxes and fees in air travel," explained Paul Hudson, President of FlyersRights. "Airlines already display these taxes and fees prominently, yet with the exception of Southwest Airlines, want to now be able to list them as prominently as, or even more prominently than, the total price."

"This proposed rule is a license for airlines to confuse, deceive, and make it more difficult for passengers to price shop," said Paul Hudson, President of FlyersRights. "Passengers need transparency in the prices on which airlines actually compete–airfare and ancillary fees–not on the mandatory taxes and federal fees that airlines do not control. The DOT, in arguing that airlines need the flexibility to display taxes and fees as prominently as the total price, would be harming passengers, competition, and the airlines that do not wish to deceive their passengers."

FlyersRights has been a long-time advocate for policies that prioritize competition, transparency, and consumer protections within the airline industry.

For more information on FlyersRights' comments and to read the full submission, visit https://www.regulations.gov/comment/DOT-OST-2025-0831-1357.

FlyersRights.org, established in 2007, is the largest airline passenger organization. It publishes a Know Your Rights guide and operates a free hotline for airline passengers at 877- FLYERS-6. FlyersRights advocates for passenger rights and aviation safety in Congress, federal agencies, and the courts. FlyersRights.org, 800- 662-1859, 4411 Bee Ridge Road #274, Sarasota, FL

For more information, contact, Paul Hudson, President of FlyersRights, 800-662-1859, paul@flyersrights.org

releases.title: Jon Batiste to Narrate American Amazon, Bringing His Signature Voice to Epic Giant Screen Documentary Featuring the South's Wildest Secrets
releases.body:
New film from Grizzly Creek Films, PBS and distributed by MacGillivray Freeman Films, opens in select IMAX and giant screen theaters starting November 13

LAGUNA BEACH, Calif., Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MacGillivray Freeman Films, the world's leading independent producer and distributor of giant screen films, announced today that acclaimed musician, composer, and storyteller Jon Batiste will narrate and serve as Executive Producer on American Amazon, the sweeping new documentary from Grizzly Creek Films and The WNET Group's award-winning Nature series for PBS. The feature film is slated to premiere in select IMAX® and giant screen theaters and museums beginning November 13, 2026, and the two-part Nature mini-series will release on PBS in early 2027.

Batiste's distinctive voice and deeply expressive artistry will guide audiences through one of North America's least explored and biologically rich regions—the vast network of wetlands spanning Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, and the Carolinas. A Louisiana native, Batiste brings a powerful emotional resonance to this immersive journey, elevating the film's celebration of nature, culture, and human connection to the ecosystem.

Four years in the making, American Amazon reveals an ancient and mysterious landscape defined by towering two-thousand-year-old cypress trees, labyrinthine flooded forests, a network of wild rivers, and an astonishing array of wildlife. From the mass migration of swallow-tailed kites—the world's only social raptor—to the elusive behaviors of American black bears in the swamp, the film uncovers a world teeming with life, discovery, and enduring surprises.

"Jon Batiste brings the American Amazon to life; his creativity, passion, and energy invite us to fall in love with this wild and mysterious place that is truly the world's best kept secret," said the film's director, writer, and co-producer Eric Bendick of Grizzly Creek Films. "His voice is a perfect match for all the drama and soul-stirring beauty of this landscape, allowing audiences to connect with the untamed spirit of the wild South."

Drawing on the filmmakers' extensive exploration in the region, American Amazon presents a remarkable collection of natural history stories—many never before captured on film. Together with Batiste's narration, the film offers an experience that is both epic in scale and deeply personal.

"Jon's ability to move between joy, wonder, and reflection makes him an ideal narrator for this story," said co-producer Thomas Winston of Grizzly Creek Films. "He brings a unique perspective that amplifies the film's message of appreciation and stewardship. American Amazon marks an exciting new chapter in our ongoing collaboration with Jon—and there's more to come."

"American Amazon shines a light on one of the most ecologically important and least understood regions in North America," said Fred Kaufman, Executive Producer of Nature. "Jon brings a rare authenticity to this story. His voice captures not only the wonder of the natural world, but also the deep cultural connection between the people, places, and wildlife that make the American South so extraordinary."

"I love introducing people to the swamp. Growing up in Louisiana, I've always felt a deep connection to the landscapes, culture, and spirit of my home," said Jon Batiste. "I think the South is sacred soil. American Amazon reveals the wild side that many people have never seen. It's a world of extraordinary beauty, mystery, and life – hiding right in our own backyard. We're celebrating the power of nature, creativity, and human connection – and this is just the beginning!"

Jon Batiste is an eight-time Grammy, Academy, and Emmy Award–winning singer, songwriter, composer, and pianist known for his genre-defying music. His 2025 album, Big Money, won the Grammy Award for Best Americana Album. In film, Batiste will next compose the score for Amazon MGM's The Thomas Crown Affair, directed by Michael B. Jordan. From 2015 to 2022, he served as bandleader and musical director of The Late Show with Stephen Colbert.

"Having worked with Jon previously on our giant screen film America's Musical Journey, I've seen firsthand the incredible artistry and range he brings to every project," said Shaun MacGillivray, President of MacGillivray Freeman Films. "He is an extraordinary talent, and his ability to connect with audiences through music and storytelling makes him the perfect voice for American Amazon."

More than a visual spectacle, American Amazon is a celebration of a fragile and irreplaceable ecosystem—and a call to action to protect this landscape – before it's too late. By sharing the region's untold stories and extraordinary biodiversity, the film aims to inspire audiences to reconnect with nature and recognize the importance of preserving these vital landscapes for future generations.

With MacGillivray Freeman Films leading distribution, American Amazon will roll out to leading science centers, museums, and giant screen theaters beginning November 2026.

About Grizzly Creek Films

Grizzly Creek Films specializes in filmmaking that marries compelling storytelling, dynamic characters, and unparalleled imagery. From their home base in Montana to locations around the world, the company produces films defined by authentic emotion, heart-pounding action, and breathtaking natural wonders.

About Nature

Since 1982, Nature has pioneered a television genre that is now widely emulated in the broadcast industry, bringing the natural world to millions of viewers. The series has won more than 800 honors from the television industry, the international wildlife film communities and environmental organizations, including 21 Emmys and three Peabodys. Nature is available for streaming concurrent with broadcast on all station-branded PBS platforms, including PBS.org and the PBS App, available on iOS, Android, Roku streaming devices, Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung Smart TV, Chromecast and VIZIO. Classic episodes are available on various FAST channel platforms and on PBS Passport. Nature is a production of The WNET Group.

About MacGillivray Freeman Films

MacGillivray Freeman Films is the world's foremost independent producer and distributor of original giant screen films for IMAX® and other large-format theaters. For more than 50 years, the company has been creating immersive, visually stunning films designed to educate, entertain, and inspire audiences around the globe. Its films have won numerous international awards including two Academy Award® nominations and three films inducted into the IMAX Hall of Fame, including Everest, the highest grossing giant screen documentary film of all time. MacGillivray Freeman's films are known for their artistry and celebration of science and the natural world. It is the first documentary film company to reach the one-billion-dollar benchmark for worldwide box office.
